title: Sr Software Engineer, Back End
description: The Company PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers. We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities. Job Summary: Zettle SMB Direct is the part of PayPal that builds the native point-of-sale experience for small and medium-sized businesses: the PayPal POS app (formerly Zettle Go) and the Zettle Terminal. Merchants use it to take card and tap payments, run checkout, manage their product library and inventory, issue receipts, handle refunds and invoices, and see what they earned. We are a growing engineering team in Bangalore working closely with colleagues in Sweden, who built much of the platform. Together we own the stack from the app on the merchant's device, through checkout and commerce services and merchant identity, down to the money movement that settles and pays out funds. We are taking over end-to-end ownership of these services, so you will learn the platform properly, then run it. Job Description: Essential Responsibilities: Delivers complete solutions spanning all phases of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) (design, implementation, testing, delivery and operations), based on definitions from more senior roles. Advises immediate management on project-level issues Guides junior engineers Operates with little day-to-day supervision, making technical decisions based on knowledge of internal conventions and industry best practices Applies knowledge of technical best practices in making decisions Minimum Qualifications: 3+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience. Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications : Your way to impact Set the technical direction for services spanning checkout, commerce, identity and money movement. Reduce operational and financial risk in payment, settlement and payout flows through better design, automation and observability. Build trustworthy data pipelines (Python, Spark, Airflow, BigQuery) that give Finance, product and merchants accurate, timely numbers for settlement, payouts, reconciliation and merchant insights. Lead the Zettle-to-PayPal convergence work on the backend, including the move of legacy merchants onto PayPal One Identity and the integration with PayPal core payments through the TAP API. Grow the team: mentor engineers, review designs, and make knowledge transfer from Sweden stick. Your day to day Lead design and delivery of larger changes such as new payment flows, integrations and migrations, writing clear design documents and decision records. Design, build and operate batch and incremental data pipelines using Python, Apache Spark and Airflow, landing curated datasets in Google BigQuery from our Java services and event streams. Own pipeline reliability: idempotent and re-runnable jobs, backfills, data quality checks, lineage, SLAs for data freshness and cost control on Spark and BigQuery. Act as incident commander for your domain; run post-incident reviews and drive the fixes. Own SLOs, alerting and capacity for your services; work with SRE and PayPal platform teams. Review code and designs for the team, and coach engineers at CL5 and below. Partner with product, Finance, security and compliance on payments, settlement, payouts and reconciliation. Run knowledge-transfer sessions with Sweden and ensure every critical service has at least two people who can operate it. What do you need to bring- 4 to 7 years of software engineering experience, with deep Java expertise (Spring Boot, Dropwizard) and a record of owning production services. Must have: hands-on Python and Apache Spark for large-scale data processing, Apache Airflow for orchestration, and Google BigQuery for modelling, querying and optimising analytical data. Experience designing reliable data pipelines: idempotency, backfills, schema evolution, data quality checks, monitoring and cost and performance tuning. Proven design of distributed, event-driven systems on AWS, including multi-region and failure-mode thinking. Strong knowledge of payments: authorization, capture, refunds, clearing, settlement, chargebacks and reconciliation. Experience with ledgers, payouts or bank connectivity is a strong plus. Working knowledge of PCI DSS scope, key management and secure access to sensitive data. Experience leading cross-team technical work, mentoring, and handling incidents as lead. Nice to have: Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) integration (data extensions, Journey Builder, API or SFTP data feeds), GraphQL federation, OAuth and identity migrations, PSD2/SCA, EU payment schemes (such as Swish or Vipps). Clear written and spoken English, and comfort working across time zones with teammates in Bangalore and Sweden. A habit of writing things down: runbooks, design notes and decision records. Curiosity about payments and a sense of care for the merchants and customers who depend on the product. Subsidiary: PayPal Travel Percent: 0 PayPal does not charge candidates any fees for courses, applications, resume reviews, interviews, background checks, or onboarding. When making an application directly, we will never ask you to share passwords, one-time passcodes (OTP), or verification codes. Any such request is a red flag and likely part of a scam. All communication regarding your application will come from official PayPal email domains. If you suspect fraudulent activity, please report it immediately. To learn more about how to identify and avoid recruitment fraud please visit https://careers.pypl.com/contact-us. For the majority of employees, PayPal's balanced hybrid work model offers 3 days in the office for effective in-person collaboration and 2 days at your choice of either the PayPal office or your home workspace, ensuring that you equally have the benefits and conveniences of both locations. Our Benefits: At PayPal, we’re committed to building an equitable and inclusive global economy. And we can’t do this without our most important asset-you. That’s why we offer comprehensive, choice-based programs, to support all aspects of personal wellbeing—physical, emotional, and financial—delivering meaningful value where it matters most. We strive to create a flexible, balanced work culture with a holistic approach to benefits, including generous paid time off, healthcare coverage for you and your family, and resources to create financial security and support your mental health. In addition, PayPal will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you are unable to submit an application because of incompatible assistive technology or a disability, please contact us at paypalglobaltalentacquisition@paypal.com. Belonging at PayPal: Our employees are central to advancing our mission, and we strive to create an environment where everyone can do their best work with a sense of purpose and belonging. Belonging at PayPal means creating a workplace with a sense of acceptance and security where all employees feel included and valued. We are proud to have a diverse workforce reflective of the merchants, consumers, and communities that we serve, and we continue to take tangible actions to cultivate inclusivity and belonging at PayPal. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology. Group/Division The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. KLA's Central Engineering organization is made up of nine Centers of Excellence (CoEs) spanning disciplines like automation, motion control, sensors, platform design, and packaging. Each CoE contributes not only technical deliverables but also deep expertise, best practices, and advanced tools that elevate both what we build—and how we build it. What You'll Do In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise. KLA is a global leader in process control and yield management solutions for the electronics and semiconductor industries. For decades, KLA has worked at the leading edge of deep science , taking on complex technical challenges that often take years to solve. By combining expertise in optics, sensors, machine learning, data analytics, and software engineering, KLA helps enable the ideas and devices that transform the future of technology. At KLA, innovation is driven by a belief that precision matters at the smallest scale —from nanometer‑level measurement to world‑class manufacturing quality. Our solutions support advanced manufacturing across wafers, integrated circuits, packaging, and printed circuit boards, making everyday technologies such as smartphones, data centers, autonomous systems, and connected devices possible. KLA fosters an engineering‑driven culture that values rigorous testing, continuous improvement, and collaboration across global teams. Software Quality Engineers at KLA contribute to products with real‑world impact while growing their careers in an environment that encourages curiosity, ownership, and long‑term technical excellence. The ICOS Division at KLA focuses on advanced optical inspection and metrology solutions for semiconductor manufacturing, with strong emphasis on component inspection, wafer safety, and high‑precision optical systems . ICOS products play a critical role in ensuring manufacturing quality, yield, and reliability for leading semiconductor customers. ICOS products operate at the intersection of optics, mechanics, electronics, and software , making them inherently complex and quality‑sensitive. The division’s success depends not only on innovation in inspection capability, but also on robust system validation, safe operation, and predictable software behavior across diverse customer environments . Job Responsibilities Test Automation Engineer Understand the system and customer workflows end-to-end by analyzing product requirements, architecture, and real customer use cases; translate these into automation strategy and test coverage for web applications and web services. Participate early in the SDLC by reviewing functional/system requirements and designs to ensure testability , identify risks, and define measurable acceptance criteria aligned with user journeys and service/API contracts. Build and maintain a scalable test automation framework using Playwright (web UI automation) with strong engineering practices (reusable utilities, page/component patterns, stable selectors, test data strategy, reporting). Automate critical user flows (smoke, regression, and high-risk business paths) by modeling realistic user behavior and validating the complete workflow across UI, backend services, and data stores. Develop automated validations for Web Services / APIs (service-level functional checks, contract validation, negative testing, error handling) and integrate them with UI flows for true end-to-end quality coverage. Apply AI-assisted automation practices to improve reliability and maintenance efficiency (e.g., smarter test generation, adaptive/self-healing approaches, and AI-enabled test execution where applicable) to reduce script fragility and speed up automation development. Create and maintain test plans, automation suites, and execution pipelines to run on-demand and on schedule; ensure results are observable via dashboards/logs/reports and are usable for release decisions. Execute and monitor automated test runs across builds; analyze failures to distinguish product defects vs. test issues , improve stability, and keep the automation suite production-grade. Measure and communicate automation coverage, ROI, quality trends, and release risk ; continuously prioritize automation work based on defect trends and usage-critical paths. Collaborate with cross-functional and global stakeholders (developers, architects, product owners, system engineers) to improve testability and promote quality best practices throughout the lifecycle Job Requirements Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Applications, Software Engineering, Automation, Electronic Engineering, or a related technical field. Familiarity with software quality control processes and a good understanding of web UI testing concepts. Proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language such as C/C++, Python, Perl, or VBScript. Experience with Visual Studio, automated testing frameworks, MySQL or Oracle databases, and Linux commands is preferred. Fluent in spoken and written English. Strong initiative, fast learning ability, proactive attitude, and excellent team spirit. Minimum Qualifications inimum Qualifications Master’s level degree with 0 years of related work experience, or bachelor’s level degree with a minimum of 2 years of related work experience. About KLA We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset. We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees. KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

description: The Company PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers. We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. We are a growing engineering team in Bangalore working closely with colleagues in Sweden, who built much of the platform. Together we own the stack from the app on the merchant's device, through checkout and commerce services and merchant identity, down to the money movement that settles and pays out funds. We are taking over end-to-end ownership of these services, so you will learn the platform properly, then run it. Reduce operational and financial risk in payment, settlement and payout flows through better design, automation and observability. Build trustworthy data pipelines (Python, Spark, Airflow, BigQuery) that give Finance, product and merchants accurate, timely numbers for settlement, payouts, reconciliation and merchant insights. Lead the Zettle-to-PayPal convergence work on the backend, including the move of legacy merchants onto PayPal One Identity and the integration with PayPal core payments through the TAP API. Grow the team: mentor engineers, review designs, and make knowledge transfer from Sweden stick. Own pipeline reliability: idempotent and re-runnable jobs, backfills, data quality checks, lineage, SLAs for data freshness and cost control on Spark and BigQuery. Act as incident commander for your domain; run post-incident reviews and drive the fixes. Own SLOs, alerting and capacity for your services; work with SRE and PayPal platform teams. Review code and designs for the team, and coach engineers at CL5 and below. Partner with product, Finance, security and compliance on payments, settlement, payouts and reconciliation. Run knowledge-transfer sessions with Sweden and ensure every critical service has at least two people who can operate it. What do you need to bring- 4 to 7 years of software engineering experience, with deep Java expertise (Spring Boot, Dropwizard) and a record of owning production services. Must have: hands-on Python and Apache Spark for large-scale data processing, Apache Airflow for orchestration, and Google BigQuery for modelling, querying and optimising analytical data. Experience designing reliable data pipelines: idempotency, backfills, schema evolution, data quality checks, monitoring and cost and performance tuning. Proven design of distributed, event-driven systems on AWS, including multi-region and failure-mode thinking. Strong knowledge of payments: authorization, capture, refunds, clearing, settlement, chargebacks and reconciliation. Experience with ledgers, payouts or bank connectivity is a strong plus. Working knowledge of PCI DSS scope, key management and secure access to sensitive data. Experience leading cross-team technical work, mentoring, and handling incidents as lead. Nice to have: Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) integration (data extensions, Journey Builder, API or SFTP data feeds), GraphQL federation, OAuth and identity migrations, PSD2/SCA, EU payment schemes (such as Swish or Vipps). Clear written and spoken English, and comfort working across time zones with teammates in Bangalore and Sweden. A habit of writing things down: runbooks, design notes and decision records. title: Senior Software Engineer - POS / Payment Systems (Linux)
description: Valor PayTech fosters a vibrant and nurturing work atmosphere that motivates employees to innovate and excel. The culture is deeply rooted in collaboration and ongoing development, offering team members abundant opportunities for professional advancement and skill improvement. Emphasizing innovation excellence and cultural expansion, the company greatly values the diversity of its workforce, believing it to be a cornerstone of its success. Role Overview We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Engineer with 7+ years of software development experience to build secure, reliable payment applications on Linux-based POS terminals . The ideal candidate combines strong C on Linux with deep knowledge of ISO 8583, EMV transaction flows, Terminal Management Systems (TMS), and payment security . You will design, develop, integrate, debug, and maintain POS software from the payment kernel interface up to the terminal application, working closely with product, QA, and backend teams. What We Are Looking For A hands-on engineer who can work across the full Linux POS stack transaction processing, ISO 8583 messaging, device and peripheral integration, networking, and on-device debugging . You take ownership of complex low-level problems, drive solutions independently, and deliver secure, high-performance payment software on resource-constrained hardware. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain POS and payment applications for Linux-based payment terminals. Develop payment components, middleware, and services in C on Linux device. Implement and integrate third party libraries, ISO 8583 message formats, packing/unpacking, and host transaction flows. Integrate EMV L2 kernels , contact, contactless (NFC), and magstripe card flows with the terminal application. Work with Terminal Management Systems (TMS) for configuration, key and parameter loading, remote updates, and application deployment. Integrate vendor device SDKs and peripherals: card readers, PIN pads, thermal printers, modems, and displays over serial, USB. Build reliable host communication over TCP/IP, TLS (OpenSSL/mbedTLS), GPRS/4G, Wi-Fi, and Ethernet , with timeouts, reversals, and retry handling. Implement secure handling of keys, PINs, and card data in line with PCI PTS, PCI DSS, and P2PE requirements. Write multithreaded, memory-safe code using POSIX threads, IPC, sockets, and signals . Manage builds with GCC cross-compilation toolchains, Make, and CMake. Debug and perform root-cause analysis across application, middleware, kernel driver, and device layers using logs . Collaborate with backend teams on host interfaces, REST APIs, and transaction integration. Participate in code reviews and enforce coding standards. Write unit and integration tests and support QA and certification teams with defect resolution. Use Git for version control. Contribute to technical design, architecture decisions, documentation, and estimates. Mentor junior and mid-level engineers and provide technical guidance to the team. Required Technical Skills POS & Payment Technologies Strong hands-on experience in POS / payment systems and POS transaction flows (sale, void, refund, pre-auth, reversal, settlement). Strong knowledge of ISO 8583 messaging and transaction processing. Working knowledge of EMV (contact and contactless) and card-scheme requirements. Experience with Terminal Management Systems (TMS) . Understanding payment security: DUKPT, Master/Session keys, HSM concepts, TR-31/TR-34 , and PCI standards is a plus. Linux & Systems Programming Expert-level C. Strong experience with Linux / embedded Linux application development. POSIX APIs: threads, mutexes, IPC, sockets, file I/O, signals is a plus. Cross-compilation with GCC/Clang toolchains, Make, CMake . Networking & Integration TCP/IP, TLS/SSL, OpenSSL Serial (RS-232), USB, and peripheral communication protocols. REST API and JSON integration; client-server error handling. Development Tools Git, Postman, Jira VS Code, Eclipse CDT, or NetBeans Software Engineering Skills Excellent debugging and troubleshooting on target hardware. Ability to work across application, payment, network, and device layers. Experience with the full SDLC, code reviews, testing, and release processes. Comfortable in a fast-paced product development environment. Preferred Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics, or a related field . 7+ years of professional software development experience. Previous experience in payment, banking, fintech, retail, POS, acquiring, or transaction-processing systems . Experience with Linux-based terminals from vendors such as PAX, Verifone, Newland, Ingenico, or Castles . Exposure to EMVCo, PCI PTS, or card-scheme certification cycles. Key Competencies POS & Payments | ISO 8583 | EMV | TMS | C | Embedded Linux | POSIX | Multithreading | Sockets | TCP/IP | TLS/OpenSSL | PCI / DUKPT | Device SDKs | Serial/USB | Make/CMake | Git | Postman | Debugging

Internal Team Training Train design, production, QA and project teams on the BlokSeT system, assembly rules and quality requirements. Support to Design Team Guide the design team on BlokSeT technical aspects – configuration, busbar systems, functional units and form of separation. description: Job Title : AR Caller Trainee (US Healthcare Revenue Cycle Management) Location :Hyderabad, Telangana (Work from Office) Shift Timing : US Night Shift (Monday to Friday, Fixed Weekends Off) Experience:** 0–1 Year (Freshers with strong communication skills welcome) Role Overview : As an **AR Caller Trainee**, you will undergo structured classroom and on-the-job training in US Healthcare Revenue Cycle Management (RCM). Following training, you will be responsible for contacting US health insurance payers on behalf of healthcare providers to verify claim statuses, investigate unpaid or denied medical claims, and ensure timely reimbursement while maintaining strict HIPAA compliance. Key Responsibilities : Training & Process Mastery : Complete intensive training on US Healthcare RCM fundamentals, HIPAA guidelines, insurance terminologies (EOB, deductible, copay, coinsurance), and basic CPT/ICD-10 coding concepts. Claim Follow-Up : Review assigned unpaid or aging claims and initiate outbound calls or check payer portals to determine accurate claim statuses. Denial & Underpayment Resolution : Identify root causes for claim rejections, denials, or underpayments, gather necessary documentation, and coordinate with internal medical billing and coding teams for timely re-submission or appeals. Accurate Documentation : Record detailed call notes, payer responses, claim reference numbers, and next-step action items in the billing/practice management software after every interaction. Target & Quality Adherence : Meet daily call volume, productivity, and quality audit benchmarks as defined by process SLAs. Compliance : Adhere strictly to HIPAA regulations and data security protocols to safeguard Protected Health Information (PHI). Qualifications & Skills : Education : Bachelor’s degree in any discipline (Life Sciences, Pharmacy, B.Com, BBA, or B.Sc graduates preferred; 10+2 / Diploma holders with exceptional communication may also be considered). Communication : Fluent spoken and written English with clear pronunciation, active listening, and neutral accent comprehension. Analytical & Problem-Solving : Strong logical reasoning to analyze Explanation of Benefits (EOBs) and resolve claim discrepancies. Technical Proficiency : Basic working knowledge of MS Office (especially MS Excel) and good typing speed (minimum 25–30 WPM with high accuracy). Shift Flexibility : Willingness to work permanently in US night shifts from the office. Pay: ₹120,000.00 - ₹180,000.00 per year Work Location: In person

Installation and updates Package the Python application as a proper Windows program. We prefer Nuitka (faster, harder to copy); PyInstaller is also acceptable. Build a professional installer (Inno Setup, MSIX or Velopack) that also sets up the WebView2 runtime. Code signing (EV certificate) so Windows SmartScreen and antivirus software trust the installer. Automatic updates with signed update files, safe rollback and minimal download size. Smooth installs on Windows 10 and 11, including PCs without admin rights where possible. 2. Performance on lakhs of invoices, including old PCs Fast startup (target under 3–4 seconds) and fast screens (under 1 second), even on 4 GB RAM Windows 10 PCs. SQLite tuning: WAL mode, proper indexes, full-text search, batched writes, efficient queries. Heavy reconciliation and reports using DuckDB or Polars instead of slow row-by-row processing. Virtualised data tables in the UI, so lakhs of rows display smoothly without freezing. Background jobs for imports, reconciliation, reports and portal tasks, so the screen never hangs. Fast Excel import and export (python-calamine, xlsxwriter) and fast PDF generation. Profiling with cProfile and py-spy, measuring before and after every optimisation. Correct layout on all screen sizes and Windows scaling levels (100%–200% DPI). 3. Reliability and support Crash reporting (Sentry), clear log files, and a “send diagnostics” option for customer support. Safe database upgrades between versions, with automatic backup and restore. Recovery from damaged or locked database files. Stable handling of multiple GSTINs and companies on one computer. 4. Security Safe storage of passwords and portal credentials using Windows DPAPI. Encryption of sensitive local data where needed (for example SQLCipher). Secure licensing: signed licences, protection against tampering, and safe offline grace periods. Secure login with email and SMS OTP (including DLT-registered SMS templates). Input validation, CSRF protection, rate limiting, and secure local server settings. 5. GST portal browser automation Reliable automation of portal workflows with Selenium or Playwright. Automatic browser-driver management, session handling, timeouts, retries and recovery. Quick fixes when the portal changes. Follow the rules strictly: the user logs in and enters captcha/OTP themselves, with no bypassing. 6. Licensing, payments and communication Licence server on secure HTTPS, with Google sign-in. Razorpay live payment integration with webhooks, invoices and refunds. Email (SMTP) for invoices, OTP and notifications; SMS OTP through a DLT-registered provider. 7. Testing and launch readiness Automated tests with pytest, plus end-to-end UI tests. A Windows test set: Windows 10 and 11, different screen sizes and DPI levels, low-RAM PCs. Install testing on clean virtual machines before every release. Dry runs of GST portal workflows before release. Supporting a closed beta with real users: collecting feedback, fixing issues fast, and improving step by step. 8. Shared codebase with the cloud platform Build screens in React and backend modules in FastAPI so the same code works in both the desktop app and the cloud SaaS. Work with the cloud team on shared data models and secure desktop–cloud sync. 9. Team and AI Use AI coding tools every day to build faster, with the judgement to check AI-generated code. Guide interns and freshers through code reviews and task planning. Desktop shell technology (for your understanding) Option Our view Python + WebView2 (pywebview) Our main approach: light, fast, works well on older PCs. Tauri (Rust shell with Python alongside) A good advanced option for the future: small installer and built-in updater. Rust knowledge is a plus. Must-have skills 3–5 years of hands-on software development experience. Has shipped a Python (or similar) Windows desktop application to real users , not only web apps. Packaging: PyInstaller or Nuitka; installers (Inno Setup/MSIX); code signing; auto-update . SQLite and performance: indexes, large data handling, profiling (cProfile, py-spy). Flask/FastAPI , plus JavaScript/React for screens inside WebView2, Electron or Tauri. Selenium or Playwright browser automation. Windows knowledge: DPAPI and credential storage, background/tray processes, DPI scaling, file permissions, Windows 10/11 differences. Automated testing (pytest) and Git. AI-first working: daily use of AI coding tools, with real examples. Good communication in English. Telugu or Hindi is a plus. Good to have DuckDB / Polars for fast data processing. Sentry or similar crash reporting. Velopack / MSIX / WinSparkle update systems. Tauri or Rust. SQLCipher or other local database encryption. Razorpay, SMS (DLT) and email integration. GST, accounting, tax or fintech software experience. PostgreSQL and cloud deployment basics. No GST knowledge? No problem. Our Chartered Accountants will train you. We value strong engineering skills, attitude and willingness to learn. What we are NOT looking for Someone with only web experience who has never shipped desktop software. Someone who ignores performance on slower computers. Someone looking only for a comfortable, routine job. Someone who copies AI-generated code without understanding or checking it. Why join Nylun Global Private Limited Build and launch a real Windows product used by businesses and CA firms across India. A real opportunity to prove yourself: you own the desktop experience, from installer to performance. Fast growth: a clear path to Senior Developer and Lead roles for people who perform. Modern stack: Python, WebView2, React, FastAPI, DuckDB, Playwright, Nuitka, AI tools. AI-first culture: work the way modern engineering teams work. Learning: learn GST and fintech from experienced Chartered Accountants. Work directly with the founders , not through layers of management. You work alongside Product Owners, function leaders, finance analysts, process owners, and Digital platform teams. WHY THIS ROLE You work directly with Finance and GBS teams worldwide, so you find out fast whether what you build works. You build agentic AI with frontier models on Pfizer’s enterprise AI platforms, connected to SAP, Snowflake, Oracle EPM and custom solutions through MCP or direct API integration. You help build and expand a shared F&GBS Data & AI Foundation (ontology, rules engine, MCP tool library, and decision ledger), so future agents don’t start from scratch. You can grow into a Senior Manager technical lead role without moving into people management. ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES Problem Discovery & Business Embedding Work in person in Chennai alongside a F&GBS Technology & AI Solutions Capability Center, while embedding virtually with an assigned Finance or GBS team. Learn the work through regular calls, screen-share walkthroughs, and process reviews, map the process, and find where AI removes effort, risk, or delay. Run discovery with business users and process owners across regions, including the US and Europe. Translate business pain points into scoped use cases with success measures agreed with the business owner. Work from Product Owner priorities and specifications, and shape them into buildable scope with the business owner. Push back when the request doesn’t match the underlying problem or it’s exposed to technical issues and limitation. Build & Ship Build agentic AI solutions end to end: agents and tools on Azure AI Foundry, Vertex AI, other market leading runtimes and Microsoft Agent Framework, Lang Graph, LangChain, MCP tool integrations, retrieval with Azure AI Search, document extraction with Document Intelligence, and the interfaces users touch. Deliver working prototypes in days and MVPs in weeks. Iterate directly with end users. Write production-quality code in Python and TypeScript/JavaScript, with tests, version control, and code review. Use AI coding agents in your daily workflow, and review AI-generated code to the same standard as your own. Build evaluation sets that prove accuracy on real finance data before release, and run them as regression tests on every change. Data & Enterprise Integration Connect solutions to enterprise Finance and GBS data and systems through governed MCP tools (or API) and certified data products, such as SAP S/4HANA, Snowflake (including Cortex), Databricks, SAP Ariba and Business Network, Oracle EPM, Microsoft 365, and other enterprise platforms. Write and tune SQL. Use and extend the shared F&GBS ontology, semantic views, and business rules instead of hard-coding logic in prompts. Follow data access, entitlement, and classification rules for financial and personal data. Controls, Compliance & Responsible AI Design solutions that hold up to SOX, Internal Audit, data privacy (GDPR, India DPDP Act), and EU AI Act review. Record agent evidence, approvals, and actions in the decision ledger, and build human review steps where AI outputs drive financial decisions. Apply Pfizer responsible AI safeguards: data access controls, prompt injection defenses, and output monitoring. Document design decisions, data lineage, and model behavior for control owners. Production & Handoff Own production readiness and ongoing support: LLMOps practice, deployment pipelines, monitoring, incident response, and run costs. Establish support ownership, runbooks, service expectations, escalation paths, knowledge transfer, and root cause analysis for production solutions. Deploy through approved pipelines on Pfizer cloud and GenAI platforms. Set up logging, tracing, monitoring, and alerting with Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and Foundry Observability. Contribute reusable components and patterns to the team’s shared library. Value & Adoption Track usage, accuracy, and hours saved. Report results to the business owner and FDE leadership. Train users and build champions in the business so adoption sticks. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS You can partner with the business, turn messy problems into working solutions, and show the impact in numbers. Experience evaluating and testing LLM output quality. Hands-on Python coding at a production standard. Working knowledge of TypeScript/JavaScript and a modern web framework such as React. Strong SQL and experience working with enterprise data platforms. Hands-on experience with Azure (preferred) or AWS cloud services, API design, and CI/CD. Track record of working directly with business users to define and deliver solutions. Clear written and verbal communication with non-technical stakeholders. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Master’s degree in a technical field, or a finance/accounting background combined with engineering experience. Working knowledge of finance processes such as record-to-report, order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, or FP&A. Experience with SAP data structures, Snowflake (including Cortex), or the Azure AI stack (AI Foundry, AI Search, Document Intelligence, Azure ML). Experience with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., Microsoft Agent Framework, LangGraph), MCP, and vector search. Exposure to ontologies, knowledge graphs, or rules engines. Experience in a regulated industry, with exposure to SOX or IT general controls. Relevant certifications (AWS or Azure Developer or Solutions Architect or other market leading runtimes). You don’t need every item on this list. If you’ve shipped AI that people use and you want to work close to the business, we want to hear from you. title: Firmware & Electronics Engineer, Wearables
description: About the job Wualt is building a smart ring for women's safety and everyday wellness. The ring senses what the body is doing and, when it matters, alerts the people a wearer trusts. We are a funded, pre-launch hardware startup heading into our first field pilots in early 2027 and launch in mid 2027. Small team, real hardware, real users, close to the founders. The role The firmware and electronics are what make the ring a product and not a prototype. We are looking for one person to own that layer end to end: the firmware on the ring, the board and its electronics, bring-up, and the path from a bench board to a device on a real finger. You would own the ring firmware and the electronics design, including schematic capture and PCB layout, and validate the hardware together with our Head of Product and our manufacturing vendor. We need a go-getter who can carry this part of the product largely on their own. Experience we expect (please read before applying) • Around 4 years (3 to 5) writing production embedded firmware in C or C++ for battery-powered devices. Wearable or small-form-factor IoT experience matters far more than total years. • Hands-on with ARM Cortex-M class microcontrollers and low-power wireless (BLE). Experience with low-power wireless SoCs is a strong plus. • You design the hardware too: schematic capture and PCB layout (Altium, KiCad or similar). You are well versed in taking a board from schematic to a working, manufacturable design, not just reading one. • Real BLE experience: GATT services, low-power connection management, bonding, and reconnection. Experience with OTA or DFU firmware updates is preferred. • Sensor integration over I2C and SPI at the register level: optical or PPG sensors, IMU or accelerometer, power sequencing, and clean sampling. • Ultra-low-power design and debugging: sleep states, power budgeting on a coin or Li-po battery, and comfort with an oscilloscope, logic analyzer, and multimeter. What we expect you to do • Own the ring firmware end to end and be accountable for a pilot-ready device. Our first field pilots start early 2027, and launch follows mid 2027. • Own the electronics: schematic capture and PCB layout for a ring-scale, space and power constrained form factor, and validate every board with the Head of Product and the manufacturing vendor. You will lay out the flex PCB and review fit and manufacturability with the mechanical and manufacturing partners before fabrication. • Bring up boards, write and maintain the drivers for the device's optical and motion sensors, and own the BLE link, power path, and charging behaviour. Integrate microphone capture and verify that audio reaches the phone alongside sensor data. • Protect signal quality at the source: deliver clean, well-timed raw sensor data that the ML and algorithms team can actually trust. • Own the firmware and electronics side of design-for-manufacture, test fixtures, and production bring-up, working with the mechanical and manufacturing vendors. • Hold the bar on reliability, power, and field behaviour, and say no to anything that will not survive a real wearer. • Measure current draw during sleep, sensor sampling and BLE transfers. Compare measured runtime against the power budget and verify charging through the ring's contacts. • Test BLE stability and reconnection with the assembled ring worn on the finger, across ring sizes and phone positions. Work with the antenna partner to diagnose weak or intermittent links. • Verify end-to-end behaviour with the mobile team: test what the wearer experiences when the battery is low, the ring restarts, or the phone disconnects and reconnects. Bonus • Wearables, health-tech, medical-device, or femtech hardware experience. • Flex or rigid-flex PCB design and small-form-factor or high-density layout. Hands-on flex layout experience is especially valuable for this role. • Battery and charging design, including wireless or inductive charging. For this ring, experience with small rechargeable cells, charger or PMIC integration, and contact-based charging is especially relevant. • Analog front-end design for biosignals. • Experience with Nordic's nRF Connect SDK, Zephyr or FreeRTOS. • Experience taking a device through certification, DFM, and a first production run. • A personal hardware project that shows you cannot stop building things. What you get • Full ownership of the firmware and electronics at a company that is weeks, not years, from putting its product on real people. • Hardware you can hold, a pilot on a real timeline, and a direct line to the founders. • Competitive salary. To apply, tell us about a battery-powered BLE device you helped take from schematic to working hardware: which parts of the circuit and firmware you personally owned, what you measured to diagnose a problem during bring-up, and how you verified the fix.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description: Overview Microsoft is a company where passionate innovators come to collaborate, envision what can be and take their careers further. This is a world of more possibilities, more innovation, more openness, and the sky is the limit thinking in a cloud-enabled world. Microsoft’s Azure Data engineering team is leading the transformation of analytics in the world of data with products like databases, data integration, big data analytics, messaging & real-time analytics, and business intelligence. The products our portfolio include Microsoft Fabric, Azure SQL DB, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure PostgreSQL, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Service Bus, Azure Event Grid, and Power BI. Our mission is to build the data platform for the age of AI, powering a new class of data-first applications and driving a data culture. Within Microsoft Fabric, the Platform team builds and operates the unified foundation that brings together all Fabric workloads into a single, cohesive experience. The platform provides shared infrastructure, governance, security, and a unified data model that enables customers to manage their entire data estate in one place. This team is central to delivering Fabric as a complete, end-to-end intelligence platform. Within the Microsoft Fabric Platform team, we are hiring a Senior Software Engineer to build Fabric's next-generation software development lifecycle (SDLC) platform: the infrastructure that takes every change from a developer's local environment through validation and deployment to production. Agentic software development is changing the scale of software engineering: GitHub reports that developers and agents made more than five times as many commits in September 2026 as they did a year earlier, and we are planning for a 50 to 100 times increase in the number of features our teams ship. Today's SDLC infrastructure was never designed for that scale, so we are rebuilding it to match that vision. We build our SDLC platform as a product: agent-driven, cloud-native backend services on Azure that provide elastic development and validation environments, high-throughput processing of every code change, and safe, progressive deployment to production across Fabric's global, multi-region footprint, with AI agents increasingly taking on work across the lifecycle, from feature development to live-site recovery to compliance and security. Every team building features for Microsoft Fabric runs on this platform, so each improvement compounds across a very large engineering organization. We approach the SDLC as a large-scale distributed systems problem, which makes this a backend product development role: we are looking for engineers who love building distributed systems and cloud infrastructure at scale, and who want to apply that to reinventing how software is built and shipped in the agentic era. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will lead the design of major components of the platform, from architecture through production. We do not just value differences or different perspectives. We seek them out and invite them in so we can tap into the collective power of everyone in the company. As a result, our customers are better served. Responsibilities Lead the design and development of cloud-native backend services for Fabric's next-generation software development lifecycle (SDLC) platform, spanning local development, validation, and deployment to production. Architect elastic, on-demand compute and environments on Azure that let engineers and AI agents develop and validate changes in isolated, production-like environments at very high concurrency. Build distributed, high-throughput services that scale gracefully with an order-of-magnitude growth in change volume driven by agentic development. Design deployment services that roll out changes safely and progressively across Fabric's global, multi-region footprint, with automated health analysis and rollback. Build AI agents into the platform itself, for example agents that recover live-site issues and keep changes compliant and secure, so the SDLC runs with minimal human toil and offers similar levels of SLA and reliability guarantees that customers of Fabric get, offered to the developers building on this platform. Partner with engineering teams across Fabric to understand their needs, identify dependencies, modernize existing infrastructure for scale, resilience, and cost efficiency, and drive adoption of the platform. Write extensible, well-tested, secure, and performant code, primarily in C#/.NET, and review designs and code to raise the engineering quality of the team. Embody our culture and values Qualifications Required/Minimum Qualifications Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 6+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python OR equivalent experience. description: Role Overview: We are looking for a dynamic and result-oriented professional to drive backend interventions, FPO integration, field operations and cluster development across Maharashtra, Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh, with Maharashtra as the base location. The role will focus on developing strong farmer and FPO networks, establishing direct sourcing channels and strengthening agricultural value chains for jaggery, edible oil, Khapli wheat and pulses. Key Responsibilities: 1. FPO Integration & Farmer Network Development Identify, onboard and develop FPOs, FPCs, farmer groups and cooperatives across Maharashtra, Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh. Build direct procurement and sourcing partnerships with FPOs for jaggery, edible oil, Khapli wheat and pulses. Drive farmer mobilisation and increase farmer participation through FPO-led sourcing models. Support FPOs in developing structured aggregation, grading, storage and procurement systems. Conduct capacity-building programmes for FPOs on quality standards, post-harvest management, sorting, grading and scientific storage. Establish long-term sourcing partnerships to improve farmer realisation, procurement efficiency and supply chain traceability. Coordinate with NABARD, SFAC, government departments, NGOs and other ecosystem stakeholders for FPO development and convergence opportunities. 2. Backend Intervention & Cluster Management Identify and develop key agricultural clusters for jaggery, edible oil, Khapli wheat and pulses. Conduct field assessments to understand crop production, acreage, farmer networks, sourcing potential and existing infrastructure. Develop cluster-wise sourcing and procurement plans based on crop cycles, market demand and business requirements. Establish collection centres, aggregation points and procurement infrastructure in collaboration with FPOs and local partners. Implement backend interventions to improve post-harvest management, storage, grading and processing capabilities. Monitor cluster-level procurement volumes, farmer participation, quality performance and operational efficiency. Identify supply chain gaps and implement interventions to reduce intermediary costs and procurement losses. Drive cluster development through partnerships with local institutions, processors and farmer organisations. 3. Commodity Procurement & Value Chain Development A. Jaggery Procurement Develop sourcing networks with sugarcane farmers, FPOs, jaggery manufacturers and local processors. Identify key jaggery-producing clusters and assess procurement potential. Monitor jaggery production, seasonal availability, market prices and sourcing opportunities. Ensure quality parameters such as moisture, colour, texture, sucrose content, purity and contamination levels. Coordinate with processors and FPOs to improve production practices, grading, packaging and storage. B. Edible Oil Procurement Identify sourcing opportunities for oilseeds such as groundnut, soybean, sunflower, sesame and other relevant crops. Support backend interventions for oilseed aggregation, cleaning, grading, storage and processing. Monitor quality parameters such as oil content, moisture, free fatty acid (FFA), purity and applicable food safety standards. Develop traceable and reliable sourcing channels through FPOs and farmer collectives. C. Khapli Wheat Procurement Develop direct sourcing channels with farmers and FPOs involved in Khapli wheat cultivation. Identify potential Khapli wheat-producing clusters across Maharashtra, Karnataka and AP. Promote farmer integration and encourage cultivation through FPO-led sourcing models. Monitor crop acreage, production estimates, harvesting cycles and market availability. Ensure quality parameters such as grain purity, moisture, foreign matter, grain size and overall quality. Coordinate cleaning, grading, aggregation, storage and procurement activities. Build traceable sourcing networks and strengthen farmer-to-market linkages. D. Pulses Procurement Develop sourcing networks for pulses and Identify key pulse-producing clusters and establish direct procurement linkages with FPOs and farmers. Monitor crop cycles, mandi prices, market arrivals and seasonal availability. Ensure quality parameters such as moisture, foreign matter, damaged grains, discoloured grains, infestation and grain purity. Coordinate aggregation, grading, sorting and storage activities. Develop sourcing partnerships with dal mills, processors, traders and farmer collectives. 4. Quality Assurance & Compliance Ensure procured commodities meet defined quality specifications and business requirements. Coordinate with Quality teams for sampling, inspection, grading and laboratory testing. Monitor commodity-specific quality parameters and identify deviations. Ensure compliance with applicable FSSAI, food safety and regulatory requirements. Conduct periodic supplier and FPO assessments to evaluate quality management practices. Drive corrective actions to minimise quality rejections and procurement losses. Promote good agricultural practices, improved post-harvest handling and scientific storage among farmers and FPOs. 5. Stakeholder Management & Reporting Build strong relationships with FPOs, farmers, processors, aggregators, traders and government institutions. Coordinate with Procurement, Quality, Finance, Warehouse and Supply Chain teams. Track cluster-wise sourcing, procurement volumes, farmer coverage and FPO engagement. Prepare regular MIS reports on procurement performance, quality, sourcing costs and backend interventions. Monitor execution of cluster development plans and ensure timely completion of field activities. Identify new sourcing opportunities and recommend interventions to improve procurement efficiency. Required Skills & Competencies B.Sc. Agriculture / MBA Agri-Business Management / M.Sc. Agriculture / Food Technology or relevant qualification. 4+ years of experience in agri-value chain development, commodity procurement, FPO integration or agricultural operations. Experience working with FPOs, FPCs, farmer collectives, aggregators or commodity processing organisations is highly preferred. Candidates with exposure to Maharashtra and Karnataka agricultural sourcing clusters will be preferred. Experience in multiple commodity categories will be an added advantage. Strong understanding of agricultural commodity value chains and procurement operations. Hands-on experience in FPO integration, farmer mobilisation and institutional partnerships. Knowledge of agricultural clusters and commodity sourcing across Maharashtra, Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh. Understanding of jaggery, oilseeds, Khapli wheat and pulses value chains. Experience in cluster development, aggregation, post-harvest management and backend interventions. Strong stakeholder management and negotiation skills. Ability to work closely with FPO CEOs, farmers, cooperatives, processors and rural institutions. Good analytical, reporting and coordination skills. Proficiency in MS Excel and MIS reporting. Willingness to travel extensively across assigned states and work at the field level.

About Amtech Amtech is a leading provider of enterprise software solutions for the packaging, printing, and manufacturing industries. Our integrated systems streamline order management, production planning, scheduling, inventory, and business analytics — empowering customers to drive efficiency, reduce costs, and improve operational performance. With a strong commitment to innovation and customer success, Amtech delivers reliable technology backed by deep industry expertise.With Vista’s investment and strategic guidance, we combine the agility of a growing technology organization with the scale, stability, and career mobility of a global software ecosystem. Our Employee Value Proposition At Amtech, our people are our greatest differentiator. We create an environment where you can: Purpose Shape the future of manufacturing and supply chain operations by delivering mission-critical enterprise software used by industry-leading organizations. Growth Access continuous learning, leadership development, and cross-portfolio opportunities through Vista’s global network — accelerating both technical and managerial career paths. Culture Work in a collaborative, transparent, and people-first environment where values, accountability, and integrity guide every decision. Innovation Engage with cutting-edge technologies, including AI-driven automation, and contribute to modernizing financial systems and operational processes across the business. Role Description Amtech is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to lead technical improvements across multiple modules and teams on a portal built for label and flexible packaging converters to make order intake efficient, intelligent, and collaborative for service representatives, distributors, and customers. You will own complex projects and major features while establishing standards, guiding architecture decisions, and improving how the entire team delivers safely and efficiently. At this level, you are a trusted technical leader who balances urgent customer needs with long-term modernization—and who sets the bar for code quality, testing, and production safety across the organization. This role emphasizes team-level impact, technical leadership, production-risk judgment, and incremental modernization of large legacy systems. You will mentor developers, lead incident response, establish database governance and testing standards, and guide architectural choices. You will think about deployment risk, customer variation, and business priorities—not just code correctness. Key Responsibilities Own projects or major features at the team level , including architecture, delivery strategy, team coordination, and measurable business outcomes. Lead technical standards for database changes, code review, testing, logging, and incident response across multiple modules. Guide architectural decisions that balance immediate delivery against long-term maintainability, deployment risk, and team capability. Lead production incidents involving financial, inventory, or shipping data—determining root cause, safe recovery, and preventive actions. Design incremental modernization strategies for complex legacy systems, prioritizing high-impact, bounded improvements over full rewrites. Establish database governance including change standards, schema compatibility, multi-customer testing, and safe migration procedures. Mentor and train developers in both technical skills (SQL Server, transaction design) and professional judgment (prioritization, risk assessment, incident response). Conduct thorough code reviews of changes to critical systems, focusing on business correctness, transaction safety, concurrency, and testability. Diagnose systemic issues (frequent defects, slow deployments, onboarding challenges) and propose solutions that improve team effectiveness. Communicate across boundaries with product, QA, customer success, and business leadership to understand priorities and constraints. AI Proficiency (L3: AI Power User) Scope: Team-wide productivity; architect AI workflows; mentor others; set organizational patterns Workflow integration: Embed AI across your team's development lifecycle—code generation, testing, documentation, refactoring, and knowledge transfer. Output risk ownership: Design validation steps appropriate to task criticality; ensure AI-generated work meets team standards before shipping. Team mentoring: Teach developers at all levels how to use AI effectively; know when to use AI and when to rely on human judgment. Pattern design: Establish team-wide standards for AI usage (e.g., "AI for boilerplate and documentation, always review; AI for core logic only with peer review"). Tool selection and governance: Evaluate AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, etc.); recommend adoption based on team needs and security constraints. Continuous improvement: Identify where AI can improve developer productivity without sacrificing quality or security. Required Qualifications Technical Leadership Senior PHP Knowledge (The Core Engine) Advanced PHP Concepts : Complete mastery of PHP 8.x features (Attributes, JIT compiler, Union Types). Design Patterns : Expert implementation of SOLID Principles, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), and Repository patterns. Enterprise Frameworks : Deep architectural understanding of modern frameworks like Laravel or Symfony. Asynchronous Execution : Designing queue workers and event systems using RabbitMQ or Kafka. Caching Layers : Strategizing multi-tier backend caching using Redis or Memcached. Testing & Quality : Implementing robust automated pipelines via PHPUnit for unit testing. Senior ReactJS Knowledge (The Front-End Interface) Advanced Lifecycle : Mastery of the Virtual DOM, custom hooks, and concurrent rendering options. State Management : Scalable architecture using Redux Toolkit, Context API, or Zustand. Meta-Frameworks : Production experience with Next.js for Server-Side Rendering (SSR) and SEO management. Performance Tuning : Preventing re-renders using useMemo, useCallback, and code-splitting lazy-loads. TypeScript Mastery : Enforcing strong typing across components, API contracts, and state engines. E2E Testing : Writing visual and behavior workflows using Cypress or Playwright. AWS Cloud Knowledge (The Infrastructure Layer) Compute & Serverless : Deploying containerized apps via Amazon ECS/EKS and building serverless logic with AWS Lambda. Data Management : Provisioning relational systems with Amazon RDS (MySQL/PostgreSQL) and NoSQL utilizing DynamoDB. Hosting & CDN : Hosting front-end assets on S3 and accelerating global delivery using Amazon CloudFront. Networking & Security : Setting up Virtual Private Clouds (VPC), managing IAM roles, and securing API Gateways. DevOps Infrastructure : Writing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) via AWS CDK or Terraform to build automated CI/CD toolchains. Expert C# architecture and patterns : Deep understanding of dependency injection, service composition, and testable boundaries around legacy code. Ability to design for incremental improvement: extracting bounded capabilities, running old and new in parallel, and rolling back safely. Expertise in transaction design, including outbox patterns and separation of database transactions from external calls. Proficiency with async/await, error handling, and graceful degradation in distributed systems. Expert SQL Server and database governance : Deep understanding of locking, concurrency, isolation levels, and deadlock prevention. Ability to design safe, rerunnable migration scripts for large production tables with considerations for blocking, compatibility, and rollback. Expertise in data validation, reconciliation queries, and detecting partial failures. Standards for database change management: idempotency, parameterized queries, peer review, and phased deployment. Understanding of customer schema variations and how to test against representative database snapshots. Testing and quality standards : Ability to introduce automated testing around static globals, databases, and legacy code without large rewrites. Design of representative test fixtures and characterization tests that preserve existing behavior. Understanding of what to test: success, validation failure, database failure, rollback, and concurrency. Recognition that tests must be maintainable; an unmaintained test is a liability. Production systems and incident response : Leadership of financial or inventory incidents: containment, root-cause analysis, safe recovery procedures, and preventive actions. Understanding of financial reconciliation and the principle that records must never be manually changed without audit trails. Systematic diagnosis using logs, execution plans, database analysis, and production telemetry. Design of observability: correlation IDs, structured logging, and business-context metrics. Modernization and architecture : Experience assessing which components should be modernized first based on business value, defect rate, and change frequency—not code appearance. Ability to compare old and new approaches (e.g., optimistic vs. pessimistic concurrency, .NET Framework vs. modern .NET) with explicit trade-offs. Skill at running old and new implementations in parallel, gradually shifting traffic, and rolling back if needed. Recognition that full rewrites carry hidden risk; incremental improvement is often safer and more effective. Technical Leadership & Soft Skills System Design : Translating complex business problems into highly scalable, distributed software architectures. Team Mentorship : Conducting rigorous code reviews and actively mentoring junior engineers. Agile Ownership : Breaking down massive epics into clear technical tasks and estimating deliverable sprint timelines. Leadership & Influence Technical decision-making : Lead discussions on architecture, database design, and framework choices; articulate trade-offs and risk. Mentoring and coaching : Help developers improve through code review, pair programming, and teaching (frameworks, patterns, business domain). Standard-setting : Establish practices for testing, database changes, code review, and incident response that apply across teams. Systemic improvement : Identify root causes of team friction (slow tests, deployment risk, onboarding burden) and propose solutions. Stakeholder communication : Explain technical constraints and risks to product, business, and leadership in business terms. General Competencies Business judgment : Quantify problems (defect rate, change frequency, support burden) before proposing solutions; avoid solutions in search of problems. Pragmatism : Balance correctness with shipping; know when to iterate vs. when to get it right the first time. Humility : Acknowledge limits of knowledge; ask questions and learn from others. Ownership : Take responsibility for team outcomes; propose improvements even when not explicitly assigned. Communication : Write clearly; explain complex topics in accessible terms; listen actively. Preferred Qualifications Experience building or leading large production systems serving millions of transactions or thousands of concurrent users. Deep familiarity with at least one complex enterprise system (ERP, financial platform, or high-volume transaction processing). Production incident response experience; familiarity with post-mortems and blameless investigation. Experience designing systems for multi-tenant or multi-customer deployments with schema and configuration variation. Leadership of database migrations on large production tables; understanding of zero-downtime deployment strategies. Mentoring multiple junior and mid-level engineers; demonstrated impact on their growth and career progression. Experience setting or improving engineering practices: code review, testing, deployment, incident response. Speaking, writing, or community contributions demonstrating communication of technical concepts. Work Environment & Culture Mature codebase : 5000+ files, 500K lines of code .You will own critical paths and improve legacy systems. Production accountability : Your decisions impact financial records, inventory accuracy, and customer success. Rigorous thinking and risk assessment are paramount. Technical leadership : Architecture and standards are set collaboratively with other senior engineers and leadership. Multi-team impact : Your standards, mentoring, and decisions affect how multiple teams deliver. Continuous learning : Large systems always have surprises; growth mindset and intellectual curiosity are essential. Autonomy with guidance : You make most decisions independently but collaborate on major architectural changes. Growth Path Within 2–3 years, a successful Senior Software Engineer will: Own 2–3 major projects or features that have measurable business impact and demonstrate your strategic thinking. Mentor 3–5 developers through significant technical challenges; demonstrate positive impact on their growth, retention, and confidence. Establish 2–3 standards or practices (database governance, testing approach, incident response, code review) that are adopted by teams. Lead 2+ production incidents or complex investigations; document findings and implement preventive actions. Guide 1–2 incremental modernization initiatives with a clear phased strategy and measurable improvements. Contribute to hiring and culture-building; interview candidates and provide technical feedback. Beyond Senior Engineer, growth leads to Staff Engineer , Principal Engineer , Engineering Manager , or Technical Fellow roles—each with different specialization but increased organizational influence. Why Join Amtech At Amtech, you will drive meaningful technical impact in a growing enterprise software organization while benefiting from Vista’s world-class ecosystem. You’ll collaborate with talented peers, leverage cross-portfolio learning programs, and help shape the future of Amtech’s Cloud API and Label Traxx platforms. Build your career with Amtech — backed by the strength, scale, and innovation culture of Vista. title: Sitecore AI Front-end Developer
description: Job Family Software Application & Development (India) Travel Required None Clearance Required None What You Will Do We are seeking a Front-end Developer focused on Sitecore AI development to build polished, accessible, and high-performing digital experiences on our enterprise Sitecore platform. In this role, you will develop reusable front-end components and Sitecore AI solutions; translate product, content, and design requirements into maintainable implementations; create intuitive visual authoring experiences; and deliver AI-enabled capabilities that improve content discovery, personalization, and customer engagement. You will collaborate with the Sitecore Architect, UX designers, content teams, marketing stakeholders, back-end and integration engineers, and external partners using Sitecore XM Cloud, React, Next.js, TypeScript, the Sitecore Content SDK, GraphQL, Experience Edge, Vercel, and modern cloud delivery practices. Develop reusable, responsive, and accessible React and Next.js components for Sitecore AI, translating approved designs into clean, maintainable TypeScript. Create flexible component data models, rendering definitions, placeholders, variants, and visual authoring configurations that enable content teams to build pages efficiently and safely. Integrate frontend applications with Sitecore Experience Edge, GraphQL, the Sitecore Content SDK, and approved APIs and services. Develop and integrate Sitecore AI capabilities—including AI-assisted search, recommendations, content discovery, and personalization—in partnership with architecture, analytics, content, and integration teams, with appropriate privacy, security, and governance controls. Collaborate with UX and design teams to ensure accurate implementation of design systems, interaction patterns, responsive behavior, and cross-browser compatibility. Optimize Core Web Vitals, rendering performance, caching, image delivery, SEO/GEO, accessibility, and client-side application behavior. Write unit, integration, accessibility, and end-to-end tests; participate in code reviews; and support automated quality checks within CI/CD pipelines. Troubleshoot complex frontend, rendering, personalization, API, deployment, and content-delivery issues using browser tools, logs, monitoring, and root-cause analysis. Implement privacy-conscious analytics and engagement tracking, including approved GA4 event contracts, consent-aware behavior, and data-layer standards. Improve frontend standards, shared libraries, documentation, development tooling, and delivery practices while mentoring peers through reviews and knowledge sharing. What You Will Need Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. At least 4 years of front-end or full-stack development experience, including hands-on delivery of Sitecore-based digital experiences and AI-enabled capabilities in enterprise environments. Strong proficiency in React, Next.js, TypeScript or JavaScript, semantic HTML, modern CSS, responsive design, and component-based development. Hands-on experience developing headless Sitecore XM Cloud and Sitecore AI solutions using Sitecore JSS or the Sitecore Content SDK, Experience Edge, GraphQL, and Vercel. Experience creating Sitecore components, content models, rendering parameters, placeholders, variants, and author-friendly visual editing experiences. Experience consuming REST and GraphQL APIs and integrating frontend applications with enterprise services such as analytics, identity, consent management, search, CRM, or personalization platforms. Working knowledge of Sitecore headless patterns, composable DXP architecture, design systems, and reusable frontend architecture. Experience with Git-based development, pull requests, automated testing, code-quality tools, and CI/CD deployment practices. Demonstrated ability to improve web performance, Core Web Vitals, accessibility, SEO, browser compatibility, security, and frontend resilience. Ability to diagnose rendering, state-management, caching, API, build, deployment, and content-delivery issues across environments. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions to technical and non-technical audiences. Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, collaborate across disciplines, and support peers through code reviews, troubleshooting, documentation, and knowledge sharing. What Would Be Nice To Have Experience with Sitecore products such as Search, CDP, Personalize, Content Hub, or SXA. Experience implementing AI-assisted search, recommendations, conversational interfaces, content discovery, or personalization within customer-facing digital experiences. Experience with Microsoft Azure or another major cloud platform and with serverless or edge-based application patterns. Familiarity with Storybook, automated accessibility testing, visual regression testing, performance testing, and modern frontend observability tools. Knowledge of SEO, answer engine optimization (AEO), and generative engine optimization (GEO) principles for structured, discoverable web content. Sitecore certification or equivalent demonstrated expertise. Experience working in regulated, high-traffic, or complex enterprise environments. Strong presentation and stakeholder-management skills. THE SKILL SET: 7+ years of professional experience in Application Security, Product Security, or Software Engineering with a strong security focus, within a modern cloud-native SaaS environment.
