title: Senior Engineer
description: Job Description About the team Domain Services builds the shared capabilities that Sage products run on. Payments and Financial Services is the domain that moves money and manages financial data for the businesses that use Sage. We build these capabilities once, so that several Sage products in several regions can offer them to their customers. The platform runs across multiple clouds and regions and handles billions of records. Correctness isn't negotiable here: a retry that isn't idempotent, or a ledger entry that doesn't reconcile, becomes a customer's problem. About the role As a Senior Engineer, you'll lead the ambiguous, cross-system and compliance-critical engineering in our domain, and you'll be trusted to release that work on your own judgement. You'll work across your pod and the neighbouring pods your changes touch. You'll decide how deeply AI-produced changes need human review, and you'll make the rest of the team better at building this way. How we build We're an AI-native engineering team. AI coding agents do most of our implementation. Engineers decide what gets built, give the agents the right context, and are accountable for what ships. Context is engineered. Specifications, decision records, conventions, agent instructions and repository memory live alongside the code. We build and maintain them as carefully as the code, because they decide what the agents get right. Verification is automated. Every change passes through a verification pipeline of tests, contract checks, static analysis and policy checks before release. We treat that pipeline as production code. Review depth follows risk. Evidence from the pipeline and human review together decide what can be released. This is a software engineering role. You won't be training models. You'll be building a regulated, high-scale platform with AI as your main tool. You may be a good fit if you Typically have 6+ years building and running production backend or distributed systems, or equivalent depth, including leading complex cross-system work from design to production. Reason carefully about data modelling, state transitions, idempotency, consistency and failure recovery. Have made AI coding tools central to how you deliver, and can show the context and verification you built around them, where you trusted them, where you didn't, and why. Have led incidents, migrations or schema changes on systems where mistakes are expensive. Explain technical risk in terms that product and business partners can act on, and challenge decisions with evidence before committing to them. Have coached other engineers and can point to how their judgement grew. What will make you stand out Financial services. Experience with payments, banking or lending systems, such as ledgers, payment flows, reconciliation and integrations with external providers. Our stack. Our services run on a range of technologies, including C#/.NET, Java and Node.js. Depth in one or more of these is particularly valuable, and we equally welcome strong engineers from other backend languages who are comfortable working across stacks. Scale and reach. High-volume data systems running across multiple regions or clouds. Resilience and security. Threat modelling, fault injection and performance testing for systems that can't fail quietly. Leverage. Tools, automations or agents you built that other teams went on to use. Location and working pattern Location: Bengaluru, India. Hybrid: three days a week in the office. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't match every line. #LI-RT Key Responsibilities What you'll do Lead the hard changes. Own regulated logic, integration contracts, schema changes and data migrations across billions of records. Shape the approach when it isn't clear. Turn an ambiguous problem into a technical design, prove the critical path early, name the dependencies and risks, and agree with Product what's essential and what's optional. Raise it early when the facts change in a way that could move the date. Work across pods. Coordinate with the pods whose systems or contracts your work touches, and bring in the Architect early when a design crosses an architecture boundary. Explain technical risk in terms Product and Solution Design can act on, challenge with evidence, and commit once a decision is made. Build for correctness at scale. Design for idempotency, consistency, concurrency, reconciliation and audit across services, clouds and regions. Set review depth by risk. Decide how deeply each kind of AI-produced change needs human review, back that decision with automated evidence, and explain it. Engineer the context. Design and maintain the specifications, decision records, agent instructions and repository memory that let AI agents make correct changes across services, and make them reusable by other pods. Own the verification pipeline. Build the automated checks, such as contract, property-based, reconciliation and fault-injection tests, that prove AI-produced changes are safe to release, and close the gap whenever something escapes. Run what you build. Lead complex incidents and migrations, always with a tested rollback path, and fix the systemic cause. Grow other engineers. Review their work and coach the judgement behind it, not just the code. #LI-RT

description: Early Careers at SmartDocs: Show Us Who You Are Freshers and final-year students welcome · No experience required · Apply with a 2–3 minute phone video Who we are SmartDocs builds procurement, contract management and spend management software for public sector organizations: state agencies, toll road authorities, cities and utilities. Associate Developer You'll learn to build software the way it's increasingly being built: working alongside AI coding agents, reviewing and improving what they produce, and owning features end to end. Good fit if you like building things and want to write code for a living. 2. Global Services Analyst You'll help customers get SmartDocs up and running: understanding how their procurement and finance teams work, configuring the platform, testing, and doing some light development where needed. Good fit if you like technology and people roughly equally, and enjoy solving business problems. 3. Global Support Analyst You'll be the person customers turn to when something isn't working: investigating issues, finding root causes, fixing what you can and working with developers on the rest. Good fit if you like puzzles, are patient, and get satisfaction from making a problem go away. Who should apply Recent graduates or students in your final year of college A degree (or degree in progress) in engineering, computer science, IT, science, maths or a related field. If your degree is something else but you're genuinely technical, apply anyway and tell us why. Curious about how technology works, and willing to learn things nobody has taught you yet Clear communicator in English, spoken and written No work experience is needed. Really. How to apply: send us a 2–3 minute video Instead of a cover letter, we'd like to see and hear from you. Record a short video on your phone introducing yourself. No editing, no fancy setup, no special software. Just you, talking to us. This is not a technical test. We're not going to quiz you on code. We want to get a sense of who you are before we meet you. What to talk about Use these as a guide. You don't need to cover them in order, and you don't need to cover all of them. Who you are. Your name, where you're from, what you studied or are studying. Something you figured out on your own. A project, a problem you solved, something you taught yourself, something you built or fixed. It doesn't have to be technical or impressive. Notes are fine, but please don't read from a script, whether you wrote it or an AI did. We want to hear you think. Find a quiet spot with decent light. Face a window rather than having it behind you. Hold your phone steady (propping it up works) and look at the camera. One take is fine. We'd rather see the real you than a polished performance. How to submit Upload your video to hr@smartdocs.ai Name the file: FirstName_LastName_Track.mp4 (for example, Priya_Sharma_Developer.mp4 , or _Undecided if you're not sure) Attach your resume (one page is plenty) Include your graduation year and a phone number we can reach you on What happens next We'll watch every video. If we'd like to take things forward, we'll invite you for a conversation with our team, followed by a short practical exercise based on the track you're interested in. We aim to get back to everyone within asap SmartDocs is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds. We're looking forward to meeting you.

title: Associate, Early Careers — Engineering, Global Services & Support
description: Early Careers at SmartDocs: Show Us Who You Are Freshers and final-year students welcome · No experience required · Apply with a 2–3 minute phone video Who we are SmartDocs builds procurement, contract management and spend management software for public sector organizations: state agencies, toll road authorities, cities and utilities. Our customers use our platform to buy goods and services, manage contracts and pay suppliers responsibly with taxpayer money. We work on Java, Angular, SAP integrations and Azure, and we use AI tools every day in how we design, build and support our products. We're hiring a group of early-career people to grow into technical roles with us. We care far more about how you think, learn and communicate than about what's already on your resume. The three tracks We're hiring into three areas. You don't need to have everything figured out. Tell us what interests you, and we'll work out the best fit together. People can and do move between tracks as they grow. 1. Associate Developer You'll learn to build software the way it's increasingly being built: working alongside AI coding agents, reviewing and improving what they produce, and owning features end to end. Good fit if you like building things and want to write code for a living. 2. Global Services Analyst You'll help customers get SmartDocs up and running: understanding how their procurement and finance teams work, configuring the platform, testing, and doing some light development where needed. Good fit if you like technology and people roughly equally, and enjoy solving business problems. 3. Global Support Analyst You'll be the person customers turn to when something isn't working: investigating issues, finding root causes, fixing what you can and working with developers on the rest. Good fit if you like puzzles, are patient, and get satisfaction from making a problem go away. Who should apply Recent graduates or students in your final year of college A degree (or degree in progress) in engineering, computer science, IT, science, maths or a related field. If your degree is something else but you're genuinely technical, apply anyway and tell us why. Curious about how technology works, and willing to learn things nobody has taught you yet Clear communicator in English, spoken and written No work experience is needed. Really. How to apply: send us a 2–3 minute video Instead of a cover letter, we'd like to see and hear from you. Record a short video on your phone introducing yourself. No editing, no fancy setup, no special software. Just you, talking to us. This is not a technical test. We're not going to quiz you on code. We want to get a sense of who you are before we meet you. What to talk about Use these as a guide. You don't need to cover them in order, and you don't need to cover all of them. Who you are. Your name, where you're from, what you studied or are studying. Something you figured out on your own. A project, a problem you solved, something you taught yourself, something you built or fixed. It doesn't have to be technical or impressive. We want to hear how you approached it. Why SmartDocs, and why this kind of work. What draws you to it? Which track interests you most. Or tell us you're not sure yet and what you're weighing. Both are fine answers. One thing we wouldn't learn from your resume. A few tips Keep it between 2 and 3 minutes. Shorter is better than longer. Talk, don't read. Notes are fine, but please don't read from a script, whether you wrote it or an AI did. We want to hear you think. Find a quiet spot with decent light. Face a window rather than having it behind you. Hold your phone steady (propping it up works) and look at the camera. One take is fine. We'd rather see the real you than a polished performance. How to submit Upload your video to hr@smartdocs.ai Name the file: FirstName_LastName_Track.mp4 (for example, Priya_Sharma_Developer.mp4 , or _Undecided if you're not sure) Attach your resume (one page is plenty) Include your graduation year and a phone number we can reach you on What happens next We'll watch every video. If we'd like to take things forward, we'll invite you for a conversation with our team, followed by a short practical exercise based on the track you're interested in. We aim to get back to everyone within asap SmartDocs is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds. We're looking forward to meeting you.

A Customer Executive (CE) describes an e-commerce campaign in plain language, such as restock, cart abandonment or catalog recommendation. description: DESCRIPTION We are looking for a Data Engineer to join our Agentic Data Platform team and help build the next generation of Amazon's Partner analytics infrastructure. You will work at the intersection of large-scale data engineering and agentic AI — designing systems that power 4,000+ standardized metrics daily, serve 900K+ Selling Partners and 30K+ Amazonians, and enable AI-driven automation across the Parter ecosystem of tools and products. Key job responsibilities 1) You will build the foundational data layer that agentic systems depend on — schema-aware, version-controlled, and optimized for programmatic access. 2) You will engineer event-driven pipelines (Spark Structured Streaming, Kafka, Kinesis) that serve as the nervous system for agentic workflows — providing the low-latency data feeds that agents consume to trigger actions, detect anomalies, and orchestrate downstream processes. 3) You will define how agents discover data, resolve ambiguity across metric definitions, and compose multi-step analytical queries against our Curated Data Layer (CDL). 4) You will build intelligent agents that own the full DataOps loop: auto-detecting schema drift, self-healing broken pipelines, orchestrating metric onboarding workflows, running data quality checks, and publishing validated datasets — all with minimal human intervention. 5) You will design the trust layer for agentic data systems: output validation agents that verify SQL correctness before execution, confidence scoring for AI-generated metric definitions, automated regression testing against known-good baselines, and escalation workflows that route low-confidence outputs to human reviewers. 6) You will lead the transformation from static, manually-maintained pipelines to agent-operated infrastructure — migrating legacy ETL to Iceberg-based incremental processing, unifying metric definitions across 12+ surfaces through agent-driven reconciliation, and building the operational backbone that enables 4,000+ metrics to be governed, published, and consumed by both humans and AI agents. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS 3+ years of data engineering experience 4+ years of SQL experience Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines Experience building large-scale, high-throughput, 24x7 data systems Experience coding, scripting, automating in at least one language (e.g., Python, C, C++, Java, Ruby, or PowerShell) PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Experience with AWS technologies like Redshift, S3, AWS Glue, EMR, Kinesis, FireHose, Lambda, and IAM roles and permissions Familiarity with API design patterns (REST, GraphQL, or MCP) for exposing data services to downstream applications, including GenAI agents and LLM-powered systems Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. On the other, you have the analytical depth required to understand why those models succeed, where they fall short, and what needs to change. You won't just be observing these models from the outside, you'll own them along with the Scientists. Their performance, their enhancements, their evolution over time, that's your responsibility. When the model needs a new feature, a re-calibrated threshold, or a fundamentally different approach to a particular corridor or condition, you're the one driving that forward in partnership with the scientists who built it. But beyond monitoring, you'll be the one identifying what's broken, proposing what to build next, and owning the analytical path from hypothesis to deployed improvement. This is a role without a single well-worn toolkit, you'll have the opportunity to continuously sharpen your skills across data engineering, statistical analysis, and model evaluation to keep pace with the problems in front of you. What makes this role particularly compelling is the combination of ownership and impact. The products you will work on drive millions in cost savings for Amazon Ops. You will also be involved in cutting-edge research. You'll need to be comfortable with ambiguity. Many of the most important questions in this space haven't been cleanly articulated yet, they emerge from patterns in the data, from model behavior that doesn't match expectations, from edge cases that only surface under certain network conditions. description: Overview At Zebra, we are a community of innovators who come together to create new ways of working. United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customer’s and partner’s needs and solve their challenges. Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. Here you are part of a team pushing boundaries today to redefine the work of tomorrow for organizations, their employees, and those they serve. You’ll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care about—locally and globally. Come make an impact every day at Zebra. What We're Looking For Our Data Science team provides Professional Services for our Enterprise SaaS Decision Management solutions that power multi-million-dollar supply chain operations. At the core of our platform is a foundational Time Series Demand Forecasting engine, which directly drives downstream optimization applications Our Data Science Team Provides Professional Services For Our Enterprise SaaS Decision Management Solutions That Power Multi-million-dollar Supply Chain Operations. At The Core Of Our Platform Is a Foundational Time Series Demand Forecasting Engine, Which Directly Drives Downstream Optimization Applications Including Inventory Allocation & Replenishment Assortment Planning & Store Clustering Initial Pricing, Promotions, and Markdown Optimization Predictive Ordering, and Size & Pack Optimization Intelligent Order Promising Retail Shrink, Fraud, & Supply Chain Anomaly Detection Workforce & Labor Scheduling Optimization The Frontier Of AI In Supply Chain To drive scalability and supercharge our analytical workflows, we are actively integrating Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and Agentic AI capabilities into our services and our SaaS platform. From autonomous data discovery/mapping and natural language forecast validation and explainability to tackling complex "cold-start" demand scenarios (such as novel promotional strategies, new product introductions, or new store openings with zero historical data), we are bridging predictive mathematical rigor with generative reasoning. As a Data Science Intern, you will not be working on toy datasets. You will collaborate with senior data scientists and domain experts to explore messy enterprise data, benchmark state-of-the-art time series models, and prototype agentic workflows that redefine how retail decisions are made. 🎯 What You Will Do Develop & Benchmark Demand Forecasting Models: Research, build, and evaluate time series models ranging from tabular gradient boosters (e.g., XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost) to modern deep neural networks and foundation models (e.g., TiDE, DenseNet, and TimesFM), and classical statistical baselines (e.g., Exponential Smoothing Methods and ARIMA) alongside Naïve Models. Conduct In-Depth Data Interrogation & EDA: Exercise your natural curiosity to deeply explore complex retail datasets, detect underlying patterns, identify anomalies, and perform root-cause analyses on unexpected demand shifts or model residuals. Power Downstream Decision Solutions: Connect demand signals into mathematical optimization algorithms and heuristic engines for allocation, pack optimization, price elasticity modeling, and workforce scheduling. Tackle Retail Anomaly & Shrink Detection: Build unsupervised and semi-supervised anomaly detection models to identify phantom inventory, shrink patterns, and supply chain bottlenecks. Work with Cloud Data Pipelines: Leverage modern data engineering frameworks on Databricks and Azure (utilizing PySpark, Delta Lake, Delta Live Tables, Unity Catalog, and SQL) to clean, aggregate, and prepare large-scale transactional POS and inventory data. Model Interpretability & Visual Storytelling: Implement explainability techniques (e.g., SHAP, feature importance) and design interactive visualization dashboards (Plotly, Streamlit) to translate complex analytical findings into clear business decisions. Explore GenAI & Agentic AI Workflows: Prototype agentic and LLM-assisted tools for automated data discovery, schema mapping, and ETL migration to scale and accelerate client onboarding. Experiment with LLMs for cold-start demand intelligence—leveraging analog matching, synthetic feature generation, and semantic understanding when historical sales signals do not exist. Build generative co-pilots that synthesize promotional halo/cannibalization effects and generate natural-language forecast validation & root-cause narratives. Minimum Qualifications 🔍 What We Are Looking For Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s, Master’s or Ph.D. (or senior-year undergraduate) in Data Science, Computer Science, Operations Research, Statistics, Industrial Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related quantitative field. Strong Core Data Science & Math Foundation: Solid understanding of statistics, machine learning principles, and time series concepts (trend, seasonality, autocorrelation, stationarity, loss functions). Proficiency in Python & Core Libraries: Hands-on experience with pandas, numpy, and scikit-learn. Relational Databases & SQL: Solid command of SQL for data extraction, joining complex schemas, aggregation, window functions, and data cleansing. Data Curiosity & Problem-Solving Mindset: A tenacious desire to dig into the "why" behind data anomalies, model performance variances, and real-world supply chain behavior. Learning Agility: A fast learner with the motivation and drive to rapidly upskill and absorb new tools, cloud environments, and domain concepts. Preferred / Nice-to-Have (Not Required – Eagerness to Learn is Key): We do not expect day-one mastery across our entire stack. If you have strong foundational skills and an eagerness to learn, we will provide the mentorship and environment for you to master these tools quickly. Exposure to cloud and distributed platforms: Microsoft Azure, Databricks (PySpark, Delta Live Tables, Delta Sharing, Unity Catalog, MLflow). Experience with gradient boosting libraries (XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost) and deep learning frameworks (PyTorch or TensorFlow). Familiarity with or interest in modern time series architectures and foundation models (e.g., TiDE, DenseNet, TimesFM). Understanding of Operations Research & Mathematical Optimization (Linear/ Integer Programming with PuLP, SciPy.optimize, OR-Tools, or Gurobi). Familiarity with retail/CPG business metrics (e.g., sell-through rate, out-of-stock rates, price elasticity, GMROI). Interest or hands-on exposure to GenAI/LLM application development, prompt engineering, or agentic frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, or OpenAI/Azure OpenAI APIs). 🚀 What You Will Gain End-to-End Ownership: Complete ownership of a high-impact capstone project solving a genuine enterprise retail supply chain challenge. Frontier AI & Enterprise Cloud Experience: Real-world experience combining cutting-edge GenAI/Agentic AI with enterprise Databricks/Azure lakehouses and time series foundation models. Direct Mentorship & Executive Exposure: 1-on-1 coaching from experienced Principal Data Scientists, culminating in an executive presentation of your findings to analytics and product leadership. Benefits We understand the importance of work-life balance and wellbeing, which is why we offer flexibility for our teams including: hybrid work, adaptable hours, Summer Flex Fridays, Focus Fridays, and an annual companywide well-being day to promote revitalization and success. title: Salesforce Business Analyst
description: Role purpose Teceze is seeking a Salesforce Business Analyst to ensure client delivery teams solve clearly defined business problems. You will connect stakeholders, processes and delivery requirements, maintain traceability from business objectives to accepted outcomes, and help users validate and adopt changes. This is a business analysis role requiring strong Salesforce literacy. Key responsibilities Identify stakeholders, decision owners and users; plan discovery activities that capture both management objectives and day-to-day operational needs. Run interviews and workshops to document current processes, pain points, controls, exceptions and opportunities for improvement. Define future-state processes with business owners and consultants, documenting what changes in systems, responsibilities and ways of working. Write clear user stories, acceptance criteria and business rules; identify nonfunctional needs and route technical questions to the appropriate specialists. Maintain traceability between business objectives, requirements, solution decisions, test scenarios and acceptance evidence. Support backlog prioritisation using business value, risk, dependencies and effort estimates provided by delivery teams. Analyse data definitions, quality issues and reporting requirements; validate that proposed measures reflect the intended business outcomes. Assess requirement changes, clarify scope impacts and present options for stakeholder decisions without silently expanding delivery commitments. Plan and coordinate UAT, prepare representative scenarios, support users, triage defects and obtain documented acceptance from business owners. Support communications, training and adoption planning; assess post-release feedback and recommend improvements against the original objectives. Required skills and experience Demonstrable experience taking requirements from discovery through delivery and acceptance on Salesforce or related CRM projects. Strong process modelling, user-story writing, acceptance-criteria definition and requirements traceability skills. Working knowledge of Salesforce objects, relationships, permissions, Flow and reporting sufficient to discuss feasible business solutions. Ability to analyse datasets, identify inconsistent definitions and communicate the business impact of data quality problems. Experience with Agile delivery and work-management tools, including backlog refinement, change analysis and UAT coordination. Strong facilitation, written communication and stakeholder negotiation skills, including managing ambiguity and conflicting priorities. Preferred qualifications Salesforce Business Analyst credentials or relevant recognised business analysis qualifications. Experience with tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence and process-modelling applications. Experience analysing AI-assisted workflows, customer data use cases or industry-specific sales and service operations. Education: Degree in a relevant discipline or equivalent practical experience. Evidence of successful delivery is more important than certification alone.

description: Overview Senior ServiceNow Business Analyst We’re looking for a Senior ServiceNow Business Analyst to lead requirements for CSM implementations and enhancements. Proven experience writing user stories, functional specifications, and process documentation at an enterprise level. As the world’s largest food and beverage company we are driven by a simple aim: enhancing quality of life and contributing to a healthier future. Our culture is based on our values rooted in respect: respect for ourselves, respect for others, respect for diversity and respect for the future.

We can trace our origin back to 1866, when the first European condensed milk factory was opened in Cham, Switzerland, by the Anglo-Swiss Condensed Milk Company. We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom. Strong SQL skills, including joins, aggregations, subqueries, data quality checks, and performance-aware query design. Ability to bridge business requirements and technical implementation in a techno-functional role. Experience with requirements gathering solution design, testing, documentation, and stakeholder communication. Understanding of data models, integrations, business rules, workflows, and enterprise application delivery. Ideally, you’ll also Prior hands-on Aera experience is a strong plus. Experience in Decision Intelligence, supply chain, planning, procurement, manufacturing, commercial, or finance use cases. Exposure to cloud data platforms, APIs, ETL/ELT, reporting, Python, or advanced analytics. Experience working in Agile or hybrid delivery models and distributed global teams. What We Look For Excellent verbal and written communication skills Ability to clearly articulate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. Strong ownership, accountability, and a delivery-focused mindset. Leadership presence and the ability to guide and mentor junior engineers. Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking. Collaborative team player who can also work independently with minimal supervision. What We Offer You At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today. To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing. title: Analyst, Audit AI OPS
description: About Coupang At Coupang, pricing decisions directly shape customer trust, category growth, market competitiveness, and long-term business trajectory. As pricing systems scale with sophisticated automation and data-driven models, identifying where customer outcomes, commercial performance, and market realities diverge requires forward-looking discovery beyond traditional reporting. The Audit Intelligence organization operates as an independent discovery engine across the pricing ecosystem. By leveraging AI technologies, advanced analytics, and rigorous audit methodologies, the team surfaces high-impact signals and empowers executive leadership to act on critical opportunities before they materialize into broader issues. Role Overview As an Audit Intelligence Analyst, you will build and run continuous intelligence systems that uncover customer trust opportunities, commercial growth vectors, competitive risks, and operational blind spots. Combining analytical rigor, business intuition, and AI-enabled workflows, you will convert large-scale operational and market data into high-value insights. Your work will directly guide pricing strategy, audit focus, and cross-functional execution. Collaborating with data engineers, AI agents, operations teams, and key stakeholders, you will detect weak signals in complex datasets before they impact customers or commercial performance. Why This Role Matters While traditional reporting explains past outcomes, this role anticipates future risks and opportunities. Operating guided by the Audit 2.0 core motto—"Find fast. Prove objectively. Escalate relentlessly. Drive fix that's permanent"—you will serve as a frontline catalyst for customer trust and price sharpness. Through synthesized customer, commercial, and market intelligence, you will safeguard customer trust and drive category competitiveness across Coupang's e-commerce landscape. What You Will Do Generate Customer Intelligence You will develop analytical frameworks that evaluate how pricing decisions influence customer trust, customer competitiveness, and long-term customer experience. Examples include, but are not limited to, identifying Blue Badge Trust risks where products may no longer meet customer trust expectations, surfacing pricing competitiveness gaps that impact customer conversion, detecting emerging price sharpness opportunities on highly trafficked pages, and identifying customer-facing pricing issues before they generate substantial dissatisfaction. Generate Commercial Intelligence You will identify commercial opportunities that improve growth, assortment quality, category performance, and customer adoption. Examples include, but are not limited to, identifying key products suffering from pricing-related performance challenges, surfacing underserved items experiencing abnormal demand declines on a MoM or YoY basis, identifying cold-start products requiring intervention, detecting seasonal recovery opportunities, and discovering long-tail or tail-of-tail products with unrealised commercial potential. Generate Market Intelligence You will continuously evaluate external competitive conditions and identify where Coupang is gaining or losing market competitiveness. Examples include, but are not limited to, competitiveness monitoring, comparative rank deterioration analysis, competitor promotion detection, external pricing movement analysis, category-level competitiveness shifts, and emerging market-share risk signals. Leverage AI Agents and Automation You will deploy modern LLMs and agentic workflows (GPT, Gemini, Kiro, Devin) to accelerate anomaly detection, automate repetitive investigations, and expand audit coverage. Examples include creating AI-assisted workflows that automatically investigate competitiveness losses, automate opportunity identification, generate summaries for leadership reviews, or support daily prioritization activities. Build Repeatable Intelligence Mechanisms You will help transform one-time analyses into scalable mechanisms that can continuously operate with minimal manual intervention. Examples include automated signal detection workflows, opportunity scoring systems, categorization frameworks, prioritization models, and intelligence dashboards used across Audit and Pricing organizations. Basic Qualifications Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. 3+ years of experience in Analytics, Business Intelligence, Operations Excellence, Audit, Marketplace Operations, Pricing, Strategy, or related disciplines. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Experience working with large datasets. Proficiency in SQL. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience with AI-enabled analytical tools. Experience using Python or automation frameworks. Experience with Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar platforms. E-commerce, marketplace, retail, or pricing experience. Experience working with Machine Learning or Applied Science teams. Type of work model Hybrid Our Hybrid work model: Coupang hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration that acts a catalyst to enrich the experience of employees. Employees are required to work at least 3 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 2 days a week, depending on the role requirement. Some businesses may require more time in office due to nature of work. Details to consider Those eligible for employment protection (recipients of veteran's benefits, the disabled, etc.) may receive preferential treatment for employment in accordance with applicable laws. Privacy Notice Your personal information will be collected and managed by Coupang as stated in the Application Privacy Notice located below. https://privacy.coupang.com/en/land/jobs/

title: Sr Analyst Product Support
description: Overview: POSITION SUMMARY STATEMENT: The Senior Product Support Analyst provides advanced technical and functional support for Herbalife digital applications to ensure reliable, high-quality, and customer-focused experiences for users across markets. This role is responsible for investigating, diagnosing, troubleshooting, and coordinating resolution for complex application issues affecting web, mobile, consumer-facing, backend, and integrated applications. The role owns escalated issues through investigation, communication, resolution, and closure; performs root-cause analysis; identifies recurring issues; and recommends product, process, automation, and operational improvements. The Senior Product Support Analyst partners closely with Product, Development, QA, Associate Services, Operations, and other stakeholders to ensure issues are accurately documented, effectively escalated, and resolved in a timely manner. This position requires hands-on technical troubleshooting skills across web and mobile applications, backend services, databases, APIs, integrations, application logs, and monitoring tools. The individual must be able to use browser developer tools, console logs, SQL, MongoDB, JavaScript, Postman, session-replay tools such as Quantum Metric, and logging/observability tools such as Splunk to investigate application behavior and customer-reported issues. The Senior Product Support Analyst may also support software projects and releases from requirements clarification through implementation, UAT, Hypercare, production validation, and ongoing maintenance. This role contributes to support documentation, reporting, and enhancement recommendations that improve application usability, reliability, and customer experience. DETAILED RESPONSIBILITIES/DUTIES: Serve as a subject-matter expert for assigned digital applications and provide Level 2 technical and functional support for web, mobile, consumer-facing, backend, and integrated applications. Own customer-reported issues from initial investigation through resolution and closure, ensuring timely communication, clear expectations, and a strong customer experience. Diagnose and troubleshoot complex application incidents, defects, service requests, and escalations using browser developer tools, console logs, network traces, application logs, dashboards, and monitoring tools. Investigate application behavior across frontend components, backend services, APIs, databases, integrations, authentication flows, and third-party dependencies. Use SQL, MongoDB, JavaScript, Postman, and similar technical tools to validate data, troubleshoot APIs, analyze application behavior, reproduce issues, and support root-cause analysis. Use session-replay and digital-experience tools, such as Quantum Metric (QM), and logging/observability tools, such as Splunk, to analyze customer journeys, identify technical errors, validate reported issues, and detect recurring trends. Provide Product, and Development teams with complete and actionable issue details, including business impact, reproducible steps, expected versus actual behavior, screenshots, logs, timestamps, API responses, and relevant data findings. Identify recurring defects, known errors, customer pain points, and support trends; recommend permanent corrective actions, product enhancements, process improvements, automation opportunities, and preventive measures. Participate in incident reviews and root-cause analysis; document and track corrective and preventive actions through completion. Support release-readiness activities, including requirements clarification, UAT, production validation, Hypercare, post-release monitoring, and stabilization support. Partner closely with Product Managers, Developers, Operations, Associate Services, and business stakeholders to investigate issues, clarify business rules, coordinate resolution, and improve product usability and reliability. Create and maintain knowledge-base articles, troubleshooting guides, FAQs, runbooks, known-error records, support procedures, reports, dashboards, and self-help materials. Contribute to support and product documentation, including user stories, use cases, process maps, requirements, acceptance criteria, application gap analysis, and enhancement requests. Identify and support automation initiatives that reduce manual effort, improve support efficiency, strengthen monitoring, and accelerate issue detection and resolution. Qualifications: REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS: Skills (Required): Strong functional and technical understanding of digital applications, system-support processes, and application-maintenance practices. Strong hands-on experience troubleshooting web-based and mobile applications. Strong understanding of digital application architecture, including frontend applications, backend services, APIs, databases, integrations, authentication, and third-party dependencies. Experience using browser developer tools, application consoles, console logs, network traces, and error diagnostics. Strong SQL skills for data investigation, validation, troubleshooting, reporting, and root-cause analysis. Working experience with MongoDB or other NoSQL databases. Working knowledge of JavaScript for browser-console troubleshooting, scripting, automation, or diagnostic activities. Hands-on experience using Postman or similar API tools for testing, validation, and troubleshooting of REST APIs and integrations. Experience using session-replay or digital-experience analytics tools, such as Quantum Metric (QM), FullStory, Dynatrace Session Replay, or similar tools. Experience using logging, monitoring, and observability tools, such as Splunk, Dynatrace, Datadog, Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Kibana/Elastic, or similar platforms. Ability to analyze and correlate session-replay data, application logs, browser-console output, network traces, APIs, backend services, and database data to diagnose complex issues. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and problem-solving skills. Ability to identify recurring issues and recommend process, product, monitoring, automation, or operational improvements. Demonstrated ability to achieve results with limited supervision. Ability to effectively manage multiple, competing, high-priority issues and projects with varying deadlines. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with all levels of the organization and simplify technical concepts for non-technical audiences. Ability to interact effectively with individuals from different countries and cultures, with sensitivity to cultural diversity. Strong interpersonal, stakeholder-management, and conflict-resolution skills. Strong work ethic with emphasis on customer service, quality, ownership, and timely resolution. Ability to function effectively as a collaborative team member. Motivated self-starter with initiative, curiosity, and the ability to learn new technologies, applications, and business processes quickly. Thorough knowledge of Software Development Life Cycle methodologies, Agile delivery practices, and information-systems concepts and terminology. Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Visio. Skills (Preferred): Experience in enterprise Internet, e-commerce, consumer-facing, web, or mobile application environments. Experience with .NET client/server, cloud-based, and service-oriented application environments. Experience with enterprise content-management systems. Experience: 8+ years of experience in application support, technical support, product support, software engineering support, systems analysis, or a related technology role. 5+ years supporting enterprise, e-commerce, consumer-facing, web, mobile, SaaS, or integrated digital applications. Experience investigating production issues involving APIs, databases, integrations, application logs, and backend services. Experience collaborating with Product, Engineering, and business teams to resolve complex technical issues. Experience in incident management, root-cause analysis, and problem management. Experience in creating support documentation, knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, or operational runbooks. Experience supporting software releases, UAT, Hypercare, and post-production stabilization. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline; equivalent relevant work experience may be considered. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS: Masters Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or related field. ITIL Foundation certification or practical experience with Incident, Problem, Change, and Knowledge Management processes. Experience supporting global, multi-market, e-commerce, or consumer digital platforms

title: Senior Security Operations Analyst
description: About Trellix Trellix is a global cybersecurity leader helping organizations build cyber resilience for the AI era. Combining AI-native security, operational threat intelligence, and automated detection and response, Trellix provides defense-grade protection at machine speed across on-premises, air-gapped, operational technology, hybrid, and cloud environments. Trellix helps customers anticipate threats, scale effective security operations, maintain business continuity, and adapt their security posture for the modern threat landscape. Working with a broad partner ecosystem and global intelligence collaborators, Trellix helps strengthen the collective defense against cybercriminals and state-sponsored attacks. At Trellix, we empower professionals at all career stages to expand their technical expertise, lead strategic initiatives, and make a tangible global impact. Whether you are an industry pioneer or an emerging specialist, Trellix provides the tools and opportunities to enhance and expand your skill set. Join our mission to scale AI-driven cyber defense alongside an AI-accelerated threat landscape, and help build a safer, more resilient future. More at https://trellix.com. Role Overview: The SOC Cloud Security Operations Analyst serves as an escalation point within the Security Operations Center (SOC) and overall Fusion Center. This role is responsible for monitoring, investigating, and remediating complex security alerts, conducting detailed technical analysis, and collaborating across different environments to mitigate threats. The ideal candidate pairs traditional SOC triage expertise with modern working knowledge of Security AI/ML tools and deep hands-on expertise in multi-cloud infrastructure security across AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Microsoft Azure, and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) About the Role : Incident Investigation & Escalation: Take full ownership of security incidents; validate findings, determine scope and impact, execute remediation, and drive root cause analysis. Multi-Cloud Security Operations: Monitor, investigate, and contain threats across hybrid and multi-cloud infrastructure environments (AWS, GCP, Azure, OCI), utilizing native cloud security controls and centralized cloud security telemetry. AI-Enabled Threat Analysis: Leverage AI/ML-driven threat detection platforms, automated investigation tools, and LLM-assisted workflows to accelerate threat hunting, alert summarization, and query generation. Forensics & Malware Analysis: Perform technical triage, dynamic malware analysis, memory/artifact collection, and detailed log analysis across endpoint, network, and cloud telemetry. Vulnerability & Threat Management: Work in concert with Security Engineering and Product Security to prioritize and remediate active exploits, misconfigurations, and vulnerabilities. Global Handoffs & Mentorship: Lead seamless shift handoffs to global counterpart teams and provide ongoing mentoring and knowledge transfer Incident Documentation & Reporting: Author comprehensive incident reports, operational briefs, post-incident reviews, and tickets while ensuring evidence integrity for Incident Response workflows. About You : 4-6 years of direct operational security experience within an enterprise Security Operations Center (SOC) or Incident Response team acting as an escalation point (Tier II). Proven track record of handling high-severity incidents across both on-premises and enterprise multi-cloud environments. Cloud Security Infrastructure Expertise (AWS, GCP, Azure, OCI) AWS Security: Hands-on experience investigating alerts from AWS Security Hub, Amazon GuardDuty, AWS CloudTrail, VPC Flow Logs, and IAM Policy/Permission boundaries. Microsoft Azure Security: Experience with Azure Sentinel, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Azure Activity Logs, NSGs, and Entra ID (Azure AD) identity threat detection. Google Cloud (GCP) Security: Familiarity with GCP Security Command Center (SCC), Cloud Audit Logs, VPC Firewall rules, and IAM conditional bindings. Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Security: Working knowledge of OCI Guardrail/Data Safe, OCI Audit Logs, Identity Domains, and OCI Network Security Groups (NSGs). Cloud Detection & Response (CDR): Solid understanding of cloud-native attack vectors (e.g., IAM credential abuse, metadata service exploitation, container escape, storage bucket misconfigurations, cross-cloud lateral movement). Artificial Intelligence & Operational AI Knowledge Working-Level Security AI Skills: Practical experience utilizing AI/ML-driven security tools (e.g., Security Copilot, AI-assisted EDR/SIEM features, automated triage playbooks). Prompt Engineering & Tooling: Ability to write effective natural language prompts to query security telemetry, generate KQL/SPL search strings, summarize complex threat reports, or analyze malicious scripts/code snippets. AI Risk Awareness: Basic understanding of security risks unique to AI integration (e.g., prompt injection, data leakage via LLMs, adversarial machine learning concepts). Core SOC & Technical Competencies Endpoint & Malware Analysis: Hands-on experience with enterprise EDR/XDR technology stacks (e.g., McAfee/Trellix, CrowdStrike, Defender for Endpoint) and dynamic malware analysis techniques. Network & OS Fundamentals: Deep technical understanding of OSI Model, TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, SMTP, routing, and deep OS internals across Windows, Linux/Unix, and macOS. SIEM & Log Analysis: Expertise in querying and correlating enterprise SIEM telemetry, identifying pattern anomalies, and reducing false positives. description: Overview: POSITION SUMMARY STATEMENT: The Senior Product Support Analyst provides advanced technical and functional support for Herbalife digital applications to ensure reliable, high-quality, and customer-focused experiences for users across markets. This role is responsible for investigating, diagnosing, troubleshooting, and coordinating resolution for complex application issues affecting web, mobile, consumer-facing, backend, and integrated applications. The role owns escalated issues through investigation, communication, resolution, and closure; performs root-cause analysis; identifies recurring issues; and recommends product, process, automation, and operational improvements. The Senior Product Support Analyst partners closely with Product, Development, QA, Associate Services, Operations, and other stakeholders to ensure issues are accurately documented, effectively escalated, and resolved in a timely manner. This position requires hands-on technical troubleshooting skills across web and mobile applications, backend services, databases, APIs, integrations, application logs, and monitoring tools. The individual must be able to use browser developer tools, console logs, SQL, MongoDB, JavaScript, Postman, session-replay tools such as Quantum Metric, and logging/observability tools such as Splunk to investigate application behavior and customer-reported issues. The Senior Product Support Analyst may also support software projects and releases from requirements clarification through implementation, UAT, Hypercare, production validation, and ongoing maintenance. This role contributes to support documentation, reporting, and enhancement recommendations that improve application usability, reliability, and customer experience. DETAILED RESPONSIBILITIES/DUTIES: Serve as a subject-matter expert for assigned digital applications and provide Level 2 technical and functional support for web, mobile, consumer-facing, backend, and integrated applications. Own customer-reported issues from initial investigation through resolution and closure, ensuring timely communication, clear expectations, and a strong customer experience. Diagnose and troubleshoot complex application incidents, defects, service requests, and escalations using browser developer tools, console logs, network traces, application logs, dashboards, and monitoring tools. Investigate application behavior across frontend components, backend services, APIs, databases, integrations, authentication flows, and third-party dependencies. Use SQL, MongoDB, JavaScript, Postman, and similar technical tools to validate data, troubleshoot APIs, analyze application behavior, reproduce issues, and support root-cause analysis. Use session-replay and digital-experience tools, such as Quantum Metric (QM), and logging/observability tools, such as Splunk, to analyze customer journeys, identify technical errors, validate reported issues, and detect recurring trends. Provide Product, and Development teams with complete and actionable issue details, including business impact, reproducible steps, expected versus actual behavior, screenshots, logs, timestamps, API responses, and relevant data findings. Identify recurring defects, known errors, customer pain points, and support trends; recommend permanent corrective actions, product enhancements, process improvements, automation opportunities, and preventive measures. Participate in incident reviews and root-cause analysis; document and track corrective and preventive actions through completion. Support release-readiness activities, including requirements clarification, UAT, production validation, Hypercare, post-release monitoring, and stabilization support. Partner closely with Product Managers, Developers, Operations, Associate Services, and business stakeholders to investigate issues, clarify business rules, coordinate resolution, and improve product usability and reliability. title: Senior Lead – Analytics & Commercial Insights
description: Role Summary Responsible for building and independently driving the Analytics function from the ground up, owning the data strategy and generating meaningful brand- and campaign-specific insights. The role involves consolidating multiple data sources, building data models, analysing consumer and campaign performance, establishing ROI benchmarks and translating complex data into commercially relevant insights and actionable business recommendations. The individual will be expected to identify opportunities to improve campaign performance, drive client engagement and generate business value through data-led recommendations. This is a hands-on individual contributor role requiring strong analytical capabilities, commercial acumen, stakeholder management and the ability to operate independently in a lean, entrepreneurial environment. KRAs (Key Responsibility Areas) 1. Build and Establish the Analytics Function Set up and independently drive the Analytics function from scratch. Define the data strategy, analytical frameworks, processes and measurement methodologies. Establish standardised campaign KPIs and performance measurement frameworks. Build scalable analytical processes and take complete ownership of the function. Work independently in a lean environment with minimal support. 2. Data Consolidation, Modelling & Management Personally consolidate data from multiple, fragmented and unstructured sources. Build structured datasets, data models and analytical frameworks. Perform data cleaning, transformation, reconciliation and validation. Ensure extremely high standards of data accuracy, consistency and reliability. Identify discrepancies, investigate data gaps and establish robust data quality processes. 3. Campaign & Consumer Analytics Analyse consumer behaviour, engagement patterns, purchase trends and campaign performance. Interpret behavioural, performance and funnel data to identify meaningful trends and opportunities. Evaluate campaign effectiveness, engagement, participation, conversion and ROI. Develop analytical models for customer segmentation, retention, propensity, churn and customer lifetime value. Identify opportunities to improve campaign targeting, engagement and overall performance. 4. Commercial Insights & Business Recommendations Proactively identify meaningful and commercially relevant insights that brands can derive value from. Translate analytical findings into actionable recommendations rather than limiting outputs to dashboards and reports. Identify opportunities for revenue growth, profitability improvement and campaign optimisation. Develop brand-level insights, ROI benchmarks and performance reports. Create industry benchmark reports and analytical inputs to support Business Development and Client Servicing teams. Identify potential upselling opportunities and new business opportunities through data-driven insights. 5. Predictive Analytics, Forecasting & AI Apply statistical techniques, predictive analytics and forecasting to identify trends and anticipate business outcomes. Develop models to support campaign uplift, customer behaviour analysis, performance optimisation and business planning. Explore and implement practical AI and machine learning applications to unlock value from existing datasets. Identify opportunities to automate analytical workflows and improve the efficiency and quality of insight generation. 6. Client & Stakeholder Management Present analytical findings, insights and recommendations confidently to clients and internal stakeholders. Translate complex analytical findings into clear, commercially relevant business narratives. Confidently explain and defend recommendations using data, evidence and business rationale. Work closely with Business Development, Client Servicing and internal teams to understand business requirements. Ensure analytical recommendations are relevant, accurate and aligned with client expectations. 7. Performance Measurement & Continuous Improvement Deliver regular actionable insight reports to internal teams and clients. Drive campaign performance improvement initiatives through data-led recommendations. Monitor campaign KPIs, engagement, participation, conversion and ROI. Continuously improve analytical processes, measurement standards and reporting accuracy. Ensure insights are implemented and their business impact is tracked. KPIs (Key Performance Indicators) Percentage of campaigns with actionable insights identified and implemented. Average uplift in engagement and participation resulting from analytical recommendations. Improvement in campaign performance, conversion and ROI. Number of upsell opportunities and business opportunities generated through data-led insights. Accuracy, consistency and reliability of consolidated data and analytical outputs. Timeliness and quality of actionable insight reports. Adoption and utilisation of analytical recommendations by internal teams and clients. Internal stakeholder satisfaction across Business Development, Client Servicing and other teams. Client feedback on the quality, relevance and commercial value of insights. Successful establishment and adoption of standardised analytics frameworks and processes. Key Skills & Experience 6+ years of relevant experience in Analytics, Business Analytics, Consumer Analytics, Marketing Analytics, Data Analytics or related areas. Proven ability to independently establish and drive an analytics function, capability or analytical processes from scratch. Strong hands-on experience in consolidating multiple data sources, building data models and performing end-to-end analysis. Strong proficiency in SQL, Excel and Python for data extraction, manipulation and analysis. Proficiency in data visualisation and BI tools such as Power BI, GA4, Metabase, Looker or Tableau. Strong understanding of statistical analysis, predictive modelling, forecasting and machine learning techniques. Practical exposure to AI-driven analytics, automation or machine learning applications. Ability to interpret behavioural, performance and funnel data and derive meaningful insights. Strong commercial acumen and the ability to translate numbers into actionable business recommendations. Excellent data accuracy, reconciliation, validation and quality assurance capabilities. Strong communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to present and defend insights. Ability to work independently, demonstrate resourcefulness and take complete ownership in a lean, entrepreneurial environment. What We Are Looking For We are looking for a hands-on, commercially minded analytics professional who can independently build and run the Analytics function. The ideal candidate should be capable of consolidating data from multiple sources, building analytical models, asking the right business questions, identifying valuable insights and translating them into actionable recommendations for brands and clients. The role requires someone who combines technical execution with commercial thinking, strong communication skills, resourcefulness and an ownership mindset.

title: Data Engineer II, Amazon Selection and Catalog Systems (ASCS)
description: Description Amazon Selection and Catalog Systems (ASCS) builds the systems that host and run Amazon's product catalog. Its distributed systems process hundreds of millions of updates across billions of physical, digital and service products, powering how customers worldwide find, discover and buy what they want. You'll join CATALIST (Catalog Analytics, Insights, Strategy and Tech), the central Business Intelligence Engineering (BIE) team in Catalog Support Programs (CSP), part of Catalog Support Operations (CSO) within ASCS. CATALIST builds self-service analytics and AI-powered insights that help ASCS find and prevent catalog issues before customers feel them. We're looking for a Data Engineer II to build the data foundation behind this work. You'll move ASCS reporting from one-off datasets to governed gold datasets and datamarts on Andes, designed for both people and generative AI (GenAI) tools such as ANDI. You'll design scalable pipelines that process petabytes of catalog, listing and offer data. You'll also own operational excellence: moving releases to continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) through Maestro CDK, automating pipeline health checks, and improving query performance and infrastructure cost. You'll partner with BIEs, Technical Program Managers (TPMs) and engineering teams across ASCS to turn business questions into reliable data products. You should be a self-starter who learns quickly, communicates clearly and raises the bar on data quality. As the team's first Data Engineer, you'll also mentor BIEs who want to grow into data engineering and help shape how the team scales its data capacity. Key job responsibilities Design and develop large-scale data structures and pipelines that support analytics, machine learning, and business intelligence across the organization Implement data ingestion solutions using both real-time and batch processing approaches, applying best practices in data modeling and ETL/ELT processes with AWS technologies and big data tools Gather and translate business requirements into scalable, maintainable technical solutions that integrate seamlessly with our overall data architecture Analyze source data systems, document findings, and collaborate with source teams to establish and share best practices Mentor and support junior data engineers by reviewing their work, providing guidance on technical decisions, and helping them grow their skills Build governed gold datasets and datamarts for ASCS programs, designed for AI use Move deployments to versioned, tested releases through continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD). Own pipeline health, run times and query performance, with AI-driven checks for data drift and stale data. Lower infrastructure (IMR) cost by retiring unused assets A day in the life As a Data Engineer II, you'll spend your time architecting and building large-scale data solutions that support analytics and insights across ASCS. You might start your day reviewing business requirements from stakeholders and the BIE team, then transition into designing data pipelines that ingest information from catalog, listing, FCs and offer data, and design them so both stakeholders and generative AI (GenAI) tools like ANDI can use them. You'll collaborate with BIEs and SDEs to evaluate different technical approaches, write and test code using tools like AWS Redshift, Spark, and Hive, and document your solutions so others can understand and build upon your work. Beyond your core responsibilities, you'll have opportunities to guide junior engineers through complex problems and contribute to discussions about which tools and technologies best serve our evolving needs. About The Team You'll join CATALIST (Catalog Analytics, Insights, Strategy and Tech), the central Business Intelligence Engineering (BIE) team in Catalog Support Programs (CSO), within ASCS. CSO runs program management, technical support and strategic initiatives that improve the customer experience. CATALIST builds self-service analytics and AI-powered insights for programs such as BLMA, Package Hierarchy (PH), World Product Catalog (WPC) Basic Qualifications 3+ years of data engineering experience 4+ years of SQL experience Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines Preferred Qualifications Experience with AWS technologies like Redshift, S3, AWS Glue, EMR, Kinesis, FireHose, Lambda, and IAM roles and permissions Experience with non-relational databases / data stores (object storage, document or key-value stores, graph databases, column-family databases) Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers.
